assets.text:
GROK DESIGN COLLABORATION — CURRENT INSTRUCTIONS

Updated October 9, 2026. This is the current collaboration rule; dated casting briefs and earlier blanket stencil-first wording are historical.



Create with freedom when the task is discovery. New characters may have invented tattoos, piercings, scars, missing limbs, prosthetics, clothing and other distinctive traits without asking permission before each idea. Make those choices deliberate, coherent and traceable. An exploratory feature is a proposal, not an approved project-wide lock.



Every NEW tattoo invented on a character must arrive in the SAME DELIVERY with a FOUR-OPTION standalone tattoo/design sheet for that motif. Label options A-D and identify which matches the on-body proof. Supply that matching artwork separately when possible. Use flat, readable black-on-white art and a transparent PNG if truly available, with no face/clothes masquerading as a stencil. Record motif, region, character-side, source/output IDs and matching option. If the standalone drawing was reconstructed after the body render, label it derived_reconstruction, identify its parent and explain differences; never claim it is the original source art.



Starting with four designs and then choosing a placement is an organized option, not a required approval gate. A creative body proof plus its four-option design sheet in the same delivery is welcome. Expand an intriguing motif to 10-12 designs only when Ziggy asks for further exploration. Do not automatically produce 10-12 for every tattoo or ask approval before all new character ideas.



Respect the scope of correction tasks. Existing Prime Hon Dolo corrections preserve his current identity, eye/know, neck blaster, selected chest treatment, grillz and piercings; a wardrobe reference does not authorize a different face or an old tattoo era. Keep Multiverse variants explicitly labelled and out of Prime handoffs unless requested. Lisan is a separate character with his own current face/neck/arm roles. The creative discovery rule does not silently turn a preservation task into redesign.



LISAN OPTIONAL ICED GRILL — APPROVED DESIGN, SEPARATE MOUTH COLLECTION

On October 9 Ziggy confirmed that LAG-cb183973ed1fc70e / LAG-LOCK-FACE.jpg has exactly the grill he wants. This look is still in play; earlier mouth inconsistency caused the pause, not rejection. Natural white teeth remain the default. For requested optional grill shots, match this image's diamond-iced upper front teeth in gold frames, gold fangs and iced lower row exactly. Keep Lisan's optional grill mouth/head states in their own collection; do not import Hon Dolo's four-gold/silver layout or his optional accessory. Ziggy authorized the matching Lisan mouth-shot round. Reuse existing mouthStateIDs where available, report received state/view coverage and defects, and preserve current Lisan identity/non-mouth detail references. This is grill-design approval, not whole-portrait approval or proof of animation fidelity. The source folder called g-superseded-refs is historical storage, not the look's current status. See grok_coordination_20261009/004_lisan_optional_grill_mouth_round.txt and the single prepared dispatch it links.



LISAN AIR BREATHER — SMALL SEPARATE CONTINUITY STUDY

Lisan does not smoke. Do not import Hon Dolo cigarette, cigar or toothpick mouth sets. The occasional thin black nose breather is a device, not a mouth prop. The requested third collection is six natural-teeth + breather states, not another 130 heads or every grill/breather combination. Use LAG-SC-48.jpg / LAG-748f2a9fd5de7813 for visible tube placement only: under the nostrils, across character-right cheek (viewer-left), toward ear/hair; hidden rear attachment is unknown. Keep current face/tattoo authority separate. Maintain geometry/contact while lips and jaw change; flag disappearing, morphing, sliding, mirrored or jewelry-merged tubing. See the six slots and reference metadata in ../lisan_al_gaib/handoffs/optional_grill_dispatch_20261009/. Stills are preparation, not proof of temporal continuity.



REUSABLE HEAD LIBRARY — STANDARD FOR DEVELOPED CHARACTERS

Follow character_head_reference_standard.txt. Keep one reusable head-and-shoulders library, a separate mouth-detail library and one full-body hero per outfit by default. Do not repeat every head angle for each outfit. Current Hon target is 50 front states plus four extra views for 20 key states = 130 unique head-state/view slots; the 50 mouth macros are separate. A roughly 40-head lighter tier may fit minor characters after selecting coverage. No universal optimal pose count is claimed. Lisan has a separately authorized natural-teeth mouth batch already active; The dedicated partial return verifies fifteen natural-mouth candidates of fifty, five of six breather views and one unaccepted optional-grill test. Thirteen received natural-mouth files say GAIIB instead of GAIB; exact coverage and defects are in ../lisan_al_gaib/reference_updates/breather_partial_20261009/. Continue that batch without restarting it. The optional grill collection and six breather proofs are separate authorized queues. Adapt nonhuman heads such as Jet Black's without inventing a human mouth.



HON DENTAL UPDATE — FOUR UPPER GOLD CAPS

Ziggy's October 9 Grok correction and confirmation supersede the old two-canines-only wording. Two central upper incisors stay natural white. Both lateral incisors and both SHORT canines are gold: four upper gold caps total. Remaining upper teeth natural; lower silver/chrome grill; two plain lower-lip hoops. Retain one hoop per nostril from the face reference; do not copy the test's septum-looking drift. The six-gold preview is an error example, not a second canon. Old source images and packaged prompts may retain the obsolete tooth pattern; keep them as history/other-role evidence and reconcile new starting frames before production. A supplied mouth still is not proof of articulation or animation fidelity.

Evidence and expected delivery: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/head_library_20261009/grok_conversation_evidence.json and expected_intake.json.



HON JEWELRY TOLERANCE — OCTOBER 9, 2026 REVIEW FOLLOW-UP

Ziggy's latest live clarification keeps one hoop per nostril, a hoop in one ear and a crystal stud in the other as the intended arrangement. Occasional single/double nostril-hoop variation or missing/different earrings may be accepted as flavor in an otherwise good shot. Record the differences; do not regenerate solely for these minor nose/ear jewelry deviations. The target still guides new work, and this tolerance is not blanket acceptance of every image or permission to ignore mouth/grill, eyebrow, tattoo or identity corrections.

Keep the explicit COCKPIT-R2-05 / HD-DROP-8ef3180997c8 teeth, eyebrow and earring repair request queued. Improve the earrings during the requested mouth/brow correction where practical, without an isolated jewelry-only reroll. Grok acknowledged this clarification. Source receipt: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/feedback/review_20261009_162912/intake.json.



HON PIERCING PLACEMENT - NATURAL ASYMMETRY TOLERANCE, OCTOBER 10, 2026 (NOTE ONLY)

The paired nostril hoops and two plain lower-lip rings remain the intended feature baseline. Mirror-perfect placement is not required. Subtle left/right differences in height, angle or spacing may be retained, or considered during an already requested final styling pass, when they look more natural. Symmetric gold-standard references still meet the criteria and remain valid. Small natural placement differences are not, by themselves, a reason to lower likeness scores or require a correction.

This is an optional final-look tolerance, not an instruction to inject flaws into every image. Do not regenerate, reroll, regrade, reopen approvals or add repair tasks for existing images just to make the piercings less symmetrical. Existing ratings, decisions, Production stages and approved component references remain unchanged. No new batch or generation is requested by this note.

This placement tolerance does not authorize extra rings, different ring shapes/materials, septum relocation, floating/merged jewelry or altered dental, tattoo, brow or identity features. The existing nose/ear variation tolerance remains separate. Preserve each scene's chosen piercing state: the selected iced r4 look and quarters sequence intentionally omit lip rings. For future motion, retain any chosen subtle asymmetry consistently; it must not become jewelry sliding or changing from frame to frame.


HON OPTIONAL EXTERNAL ICED GRILL — MATCHED HEAD COLLECTIONS

The current four-gold/silver mouth and head collection is grillState=external_off. This means the optional external iced grill is absent; retain the four upper gold caps, white central incisors and lower silver/chrome grill. Do not interpret external off as natural teeth or removal of the lower grill.

Build the requested external_iced_on collection under the same character/headRevision, with matching mouthStateID, view and headPitch slots and corresponding mouth macros. The optional accessory remains separate from the default base mouth. Counts are per grill state: keep 130 baseline head slots, the separately tracked proposed 170-slot expansion and 50 macro states distinct, and report actual coverage/takes for each collection. Do not count repeated fronts as new required slots.

Use HD-DROP-defe480b085f / GRILL-REF-ICED.jpg and HD-DROP-71cad143227a / HD-PINSTRIPE-01-chest-up.jpg as existing optional iced-grill evidence. Ziggy's favored pinstripe facial shape, curls and brow are useful identity direction, but the portrait's documented gold drip-shaped lip rings, wrong nose arrangement, malformed blaster and stray face mark remain defects. Accessory evidence is not whole-detail authority. Preserve the corrected jewelry/tattoo map and supply a consolidated corrected head reference for review.

LATEST USER SELECTION: the refined HEAD-HD-ICED-ANCHOR-LOCK-r4.jpg is received as HD-GRILLUP-40064d98db89, SHA256 40064d98db897276b80085273919ccd79ca377a068dcc2bd23c519e4038ee93e. Ziggy selected this external-iced look with lip piercings removed FOR THIS LOOK only. This is not a no-lip-ring rule for all variants, a change to the 50 external_off four-gold/silver macros, or acceptance of the GrillUp storyboard. Earlier r5 inspiration/fang-refinement requests remain history; r4 selection is no longer pending. Do not transfer the iced teeth into external_off generation. Actual source and per-panel defects: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/story/quarters_grill_change_20261009/REVIEW.txt and asset_ledger.json.



HON PROP-MOUTH REFERENCES AND HAND ART

Keep the reported 50 prop-mouth references in their own collection. Cigars, cigarettes and toothpicks are optional; record prop, grillState, visible hand, character-side, hand-tattoo variant/source ID, jewelry and occlusion. Preserve the character-right hand default unless Ziggy explicitly changes it. A holster's side is not evidence for moving the tattoo. Hidden hands or hidden ink are unknown/occluded, not a continuity pass.

The user has supplied a Leigh hearts-card on-hand example and Princess Leigh hearts/spades standalone design options. The on-body crop has Leigh inside the lower border; the sheets have Princess above/outside and Leigh beside the card. Keep both alternatives labelled, with hearts as the recorded direction. Exact matching on-body reconstruction/final layout remains unresolved; the white-background JPEG sheets are not verified original transparent stencils or automatic approved replacements. No automatic props x grill states x all angles batch is requested. Intake notes and actual sources: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/reference_updates/grill_and_hand_20261009/INTAKE_NOTES.txt and intake.json.



LISAN OPTIONAL GRILL

Lisan's default is natural white teeth, governed by LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL.jpg. Only when a task explicitly requests a grill, use LAG-cb183973ed1fc70e / LAG-LOCK-FACE.jpg for the mouth/grill design only: diamond-iced upper front teeth in gold frames, gold fangs, and an iced lower row. Historical LOCK-V2 describes that mouth design; it does not restore the old face, neck tattoos, identity or piercings. Keep the current natural-face reference as authority for those features. The optional mouth reference has SHA256 cb183973ed1fc70ec906b762fb263b29c8866934a67f9608786b712579eaf056. It is an on-body example, not standalone source art. No standalone Lisan GRILL-REF-ICED.jpg has been verified as present; do not silently map a similarly named Hon Dolo file to this role. Retaining the optional grill does not approve the rest of the historical image.



Recovering existing art is separate from inventing or reconstructing it. First identify the real source and exact bytes if available. Report original_missing honestly. A photo crop is derived_crop with parent file/hash and crop bounds; a new tracing is proposed_reconstruction. Do not label either original_stencil. A white JPEG design, a placement illustration, a transparent stencil and a photograph each have different roles.



Use the supplied stable asset IDs, exact filenames and hashes. Do not assign picture numbers from upload order, rename originals, or claim an inaccessible file was inspected. Keep unknown anatomy and source gaps explicit. For new characters, describe deliberately invented anatomy; for continuity work, don't invent hidden details as established facts.



OUTFIT RETURNS — ONE OUTFIT PARENT, VARIANTS INSIDE

Keep the same outfit under one existing outfit parent. A gun addition, gun-free version, new angle or new take is a child reference within that outfit, not a second outfit entry. For the yellow suit/jacket, reuse the existing outfit-yellow parent (catalog album hon:outfit-yellow). Known wardrobe sources include HD-DROP-6c2e98bd1125 / HD-YEL-01-chest-up.jpg and HD-DROP-84bf85a0a2da / HD-YEL-02-full-front.jpg. They provide wardrobe context, not automatic identity approval. Link each returned file to its actual source asset IDs and exact parent album; do not invent incoming IDs before files are received and registered.



Record prop state separately from view: with_gun, without_gun or unspecified. Keep front/left/right/back/three-quarter view and portrait/full-body framing in their own fields. Distinguish what was requested or provider-reported from what the image visibly confirms. A cropped or hidden hip is unspecified, not evidence that there is no gun. Preserve the current Prime face, tattoos, grill and piercings while reviewing the prop addition. An actual clothing redesign needs a separate review decision; do not merge genuinely different garments solely because their color matches.



On intake, compare exact SHA256 bytes. An exact duplicate can reuse one canonical media ID while retaining every filename, archive path and source alias. A distinct image or take keeps its own media ID/hash even when it shows the same outfit and angle. Preserve both gun and no-gun material; grouping is not deletion, replacement, favorite selection or approval. Supply a manifest that makes these parent, source, prop and view relationships explicit. A report that a batch is finishing does not establish downloaded files, successful local inspection or accepted outputs.



Follow the finite request and return protocol. For boss discovery, one portrait/proof per candidate in five reviewable rounds of ten, BOSS-001 through BOSS-050. Start the first ten; use Ziggy's feedback before each next round. No four-angle set for all fifty. Only the selected winner then gets front/back/left/right with unchanged identity. Keep incomplete batches and returned candidates distinct from accepted work.



Return actual downloadable files, a contact sheet and a manifest listing each path, source/output ID, role, motif/region where relevant, status and real SHA256 when available. Never invent hashes; null plus not_computed is valid. Do not overwrite source files. Do not infer collaborator attachment numbers or publish/send outputs elsewhere.



Story and audio follow their project brief. Hon Dolo's irony is the greedy smuggler who eventually sacrifices for love. Do not rewrite the lyric master, invent song timestamps or manufacture dialogue in silent reference proofs. Describe a future motion idea separately; generated is not approved, and a reference prompt is not a guarantee of preservation.



COORDINATION

Ziggy has authorized Codex, the CFA record keeper, to ask focused questions and correct deviations from his established direction/methodology directly with Grok. Treat those interventions as reconciliation of the existing brief, preserving Ziggy as the source of new aesthetic choices and acceptance decisions. Keep proposed expansions explicit and provide traceable files/manifests and defect reports. Local authority and delivery history are in collaboration_authority.json and grok_coordination_20261009/.



HON ACCESSORIES AND CLUB ROLES — LATEST OCTOBER 9 REVIEW

SB-06-scoundrel-detail.jpg / HD-DROP-b18c4a123579 is now user-selected authority for its visible wrist jewelry: the gold curb-link chain and partly visible black wrist strap/band. Keep these as permanent Dolo accessories, including future hand/prop views where that wrist is visible. An off-frame hand does not remove an accessory from the character. Do not invent a watch face, hidden clasp, exact dimensions or anatomical side from this tight crop. This is a component-only selection, not whole-image, tattoo or scene approval. Preserve the existing Leigh hand example and its gold-ring context separately; its artwork-transfer alternatives remain unresolved. Exact sources and limits: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/handoffs/neck_bling_20261009/permanent_accessories.json and reference_map.json.



Ziggy wants four interchangeable staple neck chains: one extremely flashy, two distinct medium-flashy choices, and one plain chain-link. He withdrew 50 each / 200. The prepared first round is 24 unique designs, six per lane, one readable design per image; stop for his selections. Only selected winners then receive missing front/three-quarter/profile/detail views (at most 16 additional images), with at most two later chain-contact proofs if needed. Those later stages are conditional, not automatic batch instructions. Keep these as accessories under Dolo, not new outfits or four chains worn simultaneously. Bare upper-chest fitting references are allowed with correct visible tattoos; use product-only display if the source cannot support a faithful on-body view. Do not invent hidden body art. The exact bounded follow-up and staged plan are ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/handoffs/neck_bling_20261009/GROK_FOLLOWUP.txt and PLAN.json. This local instruction update is not a delivery receipt or generation claim.



All 50 external_off v003 mouth macros are received, including HD-B-708df0bb5bff / VIS-HD-47_CHAIN-BITE. The latter shows a rope chain across an open mouth without a clearly established tooth clamp. It does not fulfill the separate cigar/cigarette/toothpick set, which has no verified local delivery. Reconcile existing provider files and the requested state list before replacement generation; do not order a duplicate batch because files are missing locally. Keep the external_iced_on and head-state coverage records distinct from mouth macros.



Supporting cast role decisions: former BOSS-009 / HD-RETURN-80d3ca6a6858 is the bartender who appears with Hon at the bar, not a boss. Former BOSS-006 / HD-RETURN-cafa39484145 is the club bouncer: introduce him as large, imposing and breathing heavily when Hon enters, then keep him doing his job in the background of subsequent club shots. No later conflict or action is decided. These role assignments do not approve existing rendering defects. Boss shortlist is candidates 2, 8, 5 and 10; no final boss is selected. Three supplemental shot ideas are recorded in ../visual_library/shot_materials.json with no source-panel assignment or lyric timestamp. Use ../visual_library/cast_collections.json as the current character grouping and role record; prepare scene frames before motion generation.



JET BLACK — RECURRING MISSION ROLE, USER-CONFIRMED OCTOBER 9

For Lisan Al Gaib / Meta Mirror, Jet Black is a watcher working for Lisan who carries a blueprint made freely available to everyone to help unlock their capabilities. He explains accomplishments, briefs the quest/mission and returns with progress reports and messages from the outer world. He is a fictional personification of Codex's enablement role for Ziggy; Lisan retains the choices and action. This replaces the older optional-cast-only story premise, not Jet's existing visual references or Lisan's identity. The provider's Curator name, mentor hierarchy, powers and saga remain proposals. No specific blueprint object, delivery technology, cosmology, speech or song timing is established by this update, and fictional free availability does not establish real software pricing.



Reuse received Jet images first. Map candidate source IDs to the proposed arrival, blueprint briefing, mission launch and later progress/next-dispatch functions, preserving each image's review status and known defects. These are suggested story functions to develop, not four authorized generation jobs or fixed placements in LAG-SC-01–10. No new image batch, revised visual master, remote delivery or production approval follows from this local instruction update. Canonical direction and the prepared Gemini planning handoff: ../lisan_al_gaib/story/jet_black_mission_20261009/storyline.json and STORYBOARD_HANDOFF.txt. Keep the existing source-role, finite-return and intake methods.



HON QUARTERS STORYBOARD - INTENTIONAL ACCESSORY CHANGE

GROK-HD-SB-GRILLUP-v001 is received: ten draft scene selects, eight alternatives and the selected r4 anchor. Lip-piercing state remains separate from grillState; deliberate lip-ring removal is correct for this quarters sequence and the selected r4 look, not a rule for every external_iced_on variant. Nose/ear jewelry is independent. The ten selects remain unaccepted. Review found a 02/03 filename/action mismatch, an extra hoop at the dish beat, external-off/iced dental drift, identity/tattoo/accessory changes and inconsistent reflections. Correct manifests and bounded repairs need review before motion; original filenames/order are preserved. See ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/story/quarters_grill_change_20261009/REVIEW.txt and intake_receipt.json. No new run is claimed by this instruction update.


LISAN BREATHER V3 — USER-SELECTED COMBINATION, OCTOBER 9 FINISHING PASS
Ziggy selected the browser v3 proof as successful placement of the breather on the desired character, then clarified “breather with regular teeth” and “It isn’t a default”; HaL acknowledged. This is selection of the base for breather + natural teeth with NO grill only. It does not replace the general Lisan face/default, make the breather mandatory, or approve the separate optional grill. The partial package now verifies five of six breather views, including the exact v3 original LAG-PART-1b60815fa2bb (SHA256 1b60815fa2bb4f8f488ebcf123a6a71af4cba144d06667c73b2ceeb2de053c00). BR-06 is still absent; remaining variants need review. The v3 selection stays scoped to this combination. Evidence: ../lisan_al_gaib/handoffs/optional_grill_dispatch_20261009/delivery_receipt.json.

TATTOO PLACEMENT AND FINISHING SCOPE — OCTOBER 9
The latest 36 saved user reviews were reconciled without deleting originals or promoting working-reference requests. A placement guide was sent to Chief as CFA-FINISH-CHIEF-20261009-01: one neutral head with keyed legend, one necessary forearm inset, and only the requested flat_1 stencil-only / flat_0 indexing derivatives. Preserve cursive eye on character-right/viewer-left and serif/upright know on character-left/viewer-right from lf_cheeks. lf_full is the no-forehead-dice default look; scoundrel.jpg contains an allowed optional dice look and separate forearm context. Scoundrel arm side/scale and bird/Chewie placement remain unresolved. Clean artwork and annotated guides stay separate; no new tattoos or blanket identity approval. The user’s separate n=20 hand/ring request is queued for after current returns, not started by this guide. Brief: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/handoffs/tattoo_placement_guide_20261009/START_HERE.txt. Exact sent message: finishing_pass_20261009/CHIEF_MESSAGE_001.txt; response/generation remains unverified.

HON DENTAL UPDATE — FOUR UPPER GOLD CAPS

Ziggy's October 9 Grok correction and confirmation supersede the old two-canines-only wording. Two central upper incisors stay natural white. Both lateral incisors and both SHORT canines are gold: four upper gold caps total. Remaining upper teeth natural; lower silver/chrome grill; two plain lower-lip hoops. Retain one hoop per nostril from the face reference; do not copy the test's septum-looking drift. The six-gold preview is an error example, not a second canon. Old source images and packaged prompts may retain the obsolete tooth pattern; keep them as history/other-role evidence and reconcile new starting frames before production. A supplied mouth still is not proof of articulation or animation fidelity.

Evidence and expected delivery: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/head_library_20261009/grok_conversation_evidence.json and expected_intake.json.



HON JEWELRY TOLERANCE — OCTOBER 9, 2026 REVIEW FOLLOW-UP

Ziggy's latest live clarification keeps one hoop per nostril, a hoop in one ear and a crystal stud in the other as the intended arrangement. Occasional single/double nostril-hoop variation or missing/different earrings may be accepted as flavor in an otherwise good shot. Record the differences; do not regenerate solely for these minor nose/ear jewelry deviations. The target still guides new work, and this tolerance is not blanket acceptance of every image or permission to ignore mouth/grill, eyebrow, tattoo or identity corrections.

Keep the explicit COCKPIT-R2-05 / HD-DROP-8ef3180997c8 teeth, eyebrow and earring repair request queued. Improve the earrings during the requested mouth/brow correction where practical, without an isolated jewelry-only reroll. Grok acknowledged this clarification. Source receipt: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/feedback/review_20261009_162912/intake.json.



HON PIERCING PLACEMENT - NATURAL ASYMMETRY TOLERANCE, OCTOBER 10, 2026 (NOTE ONLY)

The paired nostril hoops and two plain lower-lip rings remain the intended feature baseline. Mirror-perfect placement is not required. Subtle left/right differences in height, angle or spacing may be retained, or considered during an already requested final styling pass, when they look more natural. Symmetric gold-standard references still meet the criteria and remain valid. Small natural placement differences are not, by themselves, a reason to lower likeness scores or require a correction.

This is an optional final-look tolerance, not an instruction to inject flaws into every image. Do not regenerate, reroll, regrade, reopen approvals or add repair tasks for existing images just to make the piercings less symmetrical. Existing ratings, decisions, Production stages and approved component references remain unchanged. No new batch or generation is requested by this note.

This placement tolerance does not authorize extra rings, different ring shapes/materials, septum relocation, floating/merged jewelry or altered dental, tattoo, brow or identity features. The existing nose/ear variation tolerance remains separate. Preserve each scene's chosen piercing state: the selected iced r4 look and quarters sequence intentionally omit lip rings. For future motion, retain any chosen subtle asymmetry consistently; it must not become jewelry sliding or changing from frame to frame.


HON OPTIONAL EXTERNAL ICED GRILL — MATCHED HEAD COLLECTIONS

The current four-gold/silver mouth and head collection is grillState=external_off. This means the optional external iced grill is absent; retain the four upper gold caps, white central incisors and lower silver/chrome grill. Do not interpret external off as natural teeth or removal of the lower grill.

Build the requested external_iced_on collection under the same character/headRevision, with matching mouthStateID, view and headPitch slots and corresponding mouth macros. The optional accessory remains separate from the default base mouth. Counts are per grill state: keep 130 baseline head slots, the separately tracked proposed 170-slot expansion and 50 macro states distinct, and report actual coverage/takes for each collection. Do not count repeated fronts as new required slots.

Use HD-DROP-defe480b085f / GRILL-REF-ICED.jpg and HD-DROP-71cad143227a / HD-PINSTRIPE-01-chest-up.jpg as existing optional iced-grill evidence. Ziggy's favored pinstripe facial shape, curls and brow are useful identity direction, but the portrait's documented gold drip-shaped lip rings, wrong nose arrangement, malformed blaster and stray face mark remain defects. Accessory evidence is not whole-detail authority. Preserve the corrected jewelry/tattoo map and supply a consolidated corrected head reference for review.

LATEST USER SELECTION: the refined HEAD-HD-ICED-ANCHOR-LOCK-r4.jpg is received as HD-GRILLUP-40064d98db89, SHA256 40064d98db897276b80085273919ccd79ca377a068dcc2bd23c519e4038ee93e. Ziggy selected this external-iced look with lip piercings removed FOR THIS LOOK only. This is not a no-lip-ring rule for all variants, a change to the 50 external_off four-gold/silver macros, or acceptance of the GrillUp storyboard. Earlier r5 inspiration/fang-refinement requests remain history; r4 selection is no longer pending. Do not transfer the iced teeth into external_off generation. Actual source and per-panel defects: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/story/quarters_grill_change_20261009/REVIEW.txt and asset_ledger.json.



HON PROP-MOUTH REFERENCES AND HAND ART

Keep the reported 50 prop-mouth references in their own collection. Cigars, cigarettes and toothpicks are optional; record prop, grillState, visible hand, character-side, hand-tattoo variant/source ID, jewelry and occlusion. Preserve the character-right hand default unless Ziggy explicitly changes it. A holster's side is not evidence for moving the tattoo. Hidden hands or hidden ink are unknown/occluded, not a continuity pass.

The user has supplied a Leigh hearts-card on-hand example and Princess Leigh hearts/spades standalone design options. The on-body crop has Leigh inside the lower border; the sheets have Princess above/outside and Leigh beside the card. Keep both alternatives labelled, with hearts as the recorded direction. Exact matching on-body reconstruction/final layout remains unresolved; the white-background JPEG sheets are not verified original transparent stencils or automatic approved replacements. No automatic props x grill states x all angles batch is requested. Intake notes and actual sources: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/reference_updates/grill_and_hand_20261009/INTAKE_NOTES.txt and intake.json.



LISAN OPTIONAL GRILL

Lisan's default is natural white teeth, governed by LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL.jpg. Only when a task explicitly requests a grill, use LAG-cb183973ed1fc70e / LAG-LOCK-FACE.jpg for the mouth/grill design only: diamond-iced upper front teeth in gold frames, gold fangs, and an iced lower row. Historical LOCK-V2 describes that mouth design; it does not restore the old face, neck tattoos, identity or piercings. Keep the current natural-face reference as authority for those features. The optional mouth reference has SHA256 cb183973ed1fc70ec906b762fb263b29c8866934a67f9608786b712579eaf056. It is an on-body example, not standalone source art. No standalone Lisan GRILL-REF-ICED.jpg has been verified as present; do not silently map a similarly named Hon Dolo file to this role. Retaining the optional grill does not approve the rest of the historical image.



Recovering existing art is separate from inventing or reconstructing it. First identify the real source and exact bytes if available. Report original_missing honestly. A photo crop is derived_crop with parent file/hash and crop bounds; a new tracing is proposed_reconstruction. Do not label either original_stencil. A white JPEG design, a placement illustration, a transparent stencil and a photograph each have different roles.



Use the supplied stable asset IDs, exact filenames and hashes. Do not assign picture numbers from upload order, rename originals, or claim an inaccessible file was inspected. Keep unknown anatomy and source gaps explicit. For new characters, describe deliberately invented anatomy; for continuity work, don't invent hidden details as established facts.



OUTFIT RETURNS — ONE OUTFIT PARENT, VARIANTS INSIDE

Keep the same outfit under one existing outfit parent. A gun addition, gun-free version, new angle or new take is a child reference within that outfit, not a second outfit entry. For the yellow suit/jacket, reuse the existing outfit-yellow parent (catalog album hon:outfit-yellow). Known wardrobe sources include HD-DROP-6c2e98bd1125 / HD-YEL-01-chest-up.jpg and HD-DROP-84bf85a0a2da / HD-YEL-02-full-front.jpg. They provide wardrobe context, not automatic identity approval. Link each returned file to its actual source asset IDs and exact parent album; do not invent incoming IDs before files are received and registered.



Record prop state separately from view: with_gun, without_gun or unspecified. Keep front/left/right/back/three-quarter view and portrait/full-body framing in their own fields. Distinguish what was requested or provider-reported from what the image visibly confirms. A cropped or hidden hip is unspecified, not evidence that there is no gun. Preserve the current Prime face, tattoos, grill and piercings while reviewing the prop addition. An actual clothing redesign needs a separate review decision; do not merge genuinely different garments solely because their color matches.



On intake, compare exact SHA256 bytes. An exact duplicate can reuse one canonical media ID while retaining every filename, archive path and source alias. A distinct image or take keeps its own media ID/hash even when it shows the same outfit and angle. Preserve both gun and no-gun material; grouping is not deletion, replacement, favorite selection or approval. Supply a manifest that makes these parent, source, prop and view relationships explicit. A report that a batch is finishing does not establish downloaded files, successful local inspection or accepted outputs.



Follow the finite request and return protocol. For boss discovery, one portrait/proof per candidate in five reviewable rounds of ten, BOSS-001 through BOSS-050. Start the first ten; use Ziggy's feedback before each next round. No four-angle set for all fifty. Only the selected winner then gets front/back/left/right with unchanged identity. Keep incomplete batches and returned candidates distinct from accepted work.



Return actual downloadable files, a contact sheet and a manifest listing each path, source/output ID, role, motif/region where relevant, status and real SHA256 when available. Never invent hashes; null plus not_computed is valid. Do not overwrite source files. Do not infer collaborator attachment numbers or publish/send outputs elsewhere.



Story and audio follow their project brief. Hon Dolo's irony is the greedy smuggler who eventually sacrifices for love. Do not rewrite the lyric master, invent song timestamps or manufacture dialogue in silent reference proofs. Describe a future motion idea separately; generated is not approved, and a reference prompt is not a guarantee of preservation.



COORDINATION

Ziggy has authorized Codex, the CFA record keeper, to ask focused questions and correct deviations from his established direction/methodology directly with Grok. Treat those interventions as reconciliation of the existing brief, preserving Ziggy as the source of new aesthetic choices and acceptance decisions. Keep proposed expansions explicit and provide traceable files/manifests and defect reports. Local authority and delivery history are in collaboration_authority.json and grok_coordination_20261009/.



HON ACCESSORIES AND CLUB ROLES — LATEST OCTOBER 9 REVIEW

SB-06-scoundrel-detail.jpg / HD-DROP-b18c4a123579 is now user-selected authority for its visible wrist jewelry: the gold curb-link chain and partly visible black wrist strap/band. Keep these as permanent Dolo accessories, including future hand/prop views where that wrist is visible. An off-frame hand does not remove an accessory from the character. Do not invent a watch face, hidden clasp, exact dimensions or anatomical side from this tight crop. This is a component-only selection, not whole-image, tattoo or scene approval. Preserve the existing Leigh hand example and its gold-ring context separately; its artwork-transfer alternatives remain unresolved. Exact sources and limits: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/handoffs/neck_bling_20261009/permanent_accessories.json and reference_map.json.



Ziggy wants four interchangeable staple neck chains: one extremely flashy, two distinct medium-flashy choices, and one plain chain-link. He withdrew 50 each / 200. The prepared first round is 24 unique designs, six per lane, one readable design per image; stop for his selections. Only selected winners then receive missing front/three-quarter/profile/detail views (at most 16 additional images), with at most two later chain-contact proofs if needed. Those later stages are conditional, not automatic batch instructions. Keep these as accessories under Dolo, not new outfits or four chains worn simultaneously. Bare upper-chest fitting references are allowed with correct visible tattoos; use product-only display if the source cannot support a faithful on-body view. Do not invent hidden body art. The exact bounded follow-up and staged plan are ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/handoffs/neck_bling_20261009/GROK_FOLLOWUP.txt and PLAN.json. This local instruction update is not a delivery receipt or generation claim.



All 50 external_off v003 mouth macros are received, including HD-B-708df0bb5bff / VIS-HD-47_CHAIN-BITE. The latter shows a rope chain across an open mouth without a clearly established tooth clamp. It does not fulfill the separate cigar/cigarette/toothpick set, which has no verified local delivery. Reconcile existing provider files and the requested state list before replacement generation; do not order a duplicate batch because files are missing locally. Keep the external_iced_on and head-state coverage records distinct from mouth macros.



Supporting cast role decisions: former BOSS-009 / HD-RETURN-80d3ca6a6858 is the bartender who appears with Hon at the bar, not a boss. Former BOSS-006 / HD-RETURN-cafa39484145 is the club bouncer: introduce him as large, imposing and breathing heavily when Hon enters, then keep him doing his job in the background of subsequent club shots. No later conflict or action is decided. These role assignments do not approve existing rendering defects. Boss shortlist is candidates 2, 8, 5 and 10; no final boss is selected. Three supplemental shot ideas are recorded in ../visual_library/shot_materials.json with no source-panel assignment or lyric timestamp. Use ../visual_library/cast_collections.json as the current character grouping and role record; prepare scene frames before motion generation.



JET BLACK — RECURRING MISSION ROLE, USER-CONFIRMED OCTOBER 9

For Lisan Al Gaib / Meta Mirror, Jet Black is a watcher working for Lisan who carries a blueprint made freely available to everyone to help unlock their capabilities. He explains accomplishments, briefs the quest/mission and returns with progress reports and messages from the outer world. He is a fictional personification of Codex's enablement role for Ziggy; Lisan retains the choices and action. This replaces the older optional-cast-only story premise, not Jet's existing visual references or Lisan's identity. The provider's Curator name, mentor hierarchy, powers and saga remain proposals. No specific blueprint object, delivery technology, cosmology, speech or song timing is established by this update, and fictional free availability does not establish real software pricing.



Reuse received Jet images first. Map candidate source IDs to the proposed arrival, blueprint briefing, mission launch and later progress/next-dispatch functions, preserving each image's review status and known defects. These are suggested story functions to develop, not four authorized generation jobs or fixed placements in LAG-SC-01–10. No new image batch, revised visual master, remote delivery or production approval follows from this local instruction update. Canonical direction and the prepared Gemini planning handoff: ../lisan_al_gaib/story/jet_black_mission_20261009/storyline.json and STORYBOARD_HANDOFF.txt. Keep the existing source-role, finite-return and intake methods.



HON QUARTERS STORYBOARD - INTENTIONAL ACCESSORY CHANGE

GROK-HD-SB-GRILLUP-v001 is received: ten draft scene selects, eight alternatives and the selected r4 anchor. Lip-piercing state remains separate from grillState; deliberate lip-ring removal is correct for this quarters sequence and the selected r4 look, not a rule for every external_iced_on variant. Nose/ear jewelry is independent. The ten selects remain unaccepted. Review found a 02/03 filename/action mismatch, an extra hoop at the dish beat, external-off/iced dental drift, identity/tattoo/accessory changes and inconsistent reflections. Correct manifests and bounded repairs need review before motion; original filenames/order are preserved. See ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/story/quarters_grill_change_20261009/REVIEW.txt and intake_receipt.json. No new run is claimed by this instruction update.


LISAN BREATHER V3 — USER-SELECTED COMBINATION, OCTOBER 9 FINISHING PASS
Ziggy selected the browser v3 proof as successful placement of the breather on the desired character, then clarified “breather with regular teeth” and “It isn’t a default”; HaL acknowledged. This is selection of the base for breather + natural teeth with NO grill only. It does not replace the general Lisan face/default, make the breather mandatory, or approve the separate optional grill. The partial package now verifies five of six breather views, including the exact v3 original LAG-PART-1b60815fa2bb (SHA256 1b60815fa2bb4f8f488ebcf123a6a71af4cba144d06667c73b2ceeb2de053c00). BR-06 is still absent; remaining variants need review. The v3 selection stays scoped to this combination. Evidence: ../lisan_al_gaib/handoffs/optional_grill_dispatch_20261009/delivery_receipt.json.

TATTOO PLACEMENT AND FINISHING SCOPE — OCTOBER 9
The latest 36 saved user reviews were reconciled without deleting originals or promoting working-reference requests. A placement guide was sent to Chief as CFA-FINISH-CHIEF-20261009-01: one neutral head with keyed legend, one necessary forearm inset, and only the requested flat_1 stencil-only / flat_0 indexing derivatives. Preserve cursive eye on character-right/viewer-left and serif/upright know on character-left/viewer-right from lf_cheeks. lf_full is the no-forehead-dice default look; scoundrel.jpg contains an allowed optional dice look and separate forearm context. Scoundrel arm side/scale and bird/Chewie placement remain unresolved. Clean artwork and annotated guides stay separate; no new tattoos or blanket identity approval. The user’s separate n=20 hand/ring request is queued for after current returns, not started by this guide. Brief: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/handoffs/tattoo_placement_guide_20261009/START_HERE.txt. Exact sent message: finishing_pass_20261009/CHIEF_MESSAGE_001.txt; response/generation remains unverified.

EXISTING-CATALOG TATTOO RECOVERY AUDIT
2026-10-08 — fixed 422-image existing-catalog snapshot

Source index: .cache/visual_library_20261008/tattoo_audit/index.json
Source-index SHA-256: 91588a090002304daad7b6a96c6118c3cbef94e792e63543be9926d4361c452b

READ THIS FIRST
- All 422 indexed images were visually reviewed at contact-sheet overview scale, across all 22 sheets. This is NOT an all-images full-resolution tattoo audit.
- Audit index numbers 1–422 are contact-sheet inventory positions, NOT HD-EXP numbers or creative approval ranks. Identify sources using the exact asset ID, filename, repository path and SHA-256 together.
- Only six individual source files were additionally opened by this reviewer: indices 102, 213, 256, 260, 333 and 421. Parent separately reported eleven close-up checks; attribution is explicit in each record.
- Each image has an overview record even when no readable ink is visible. Covered skin, small knuckle marks, dark areas, backs under clothing, reflected sides and hidden wraparound lines remain unknown.
- No readable motif means none identified in this view at this scale; it does not prove the character has no tattoos elsewhere.
- Artwork family similarity does not prove exact design identity. Distinct body variants require separate source-art recovery and body-match evidence.
- Source file existence, dimensions and SHA-256 were checked for all records. Hash checks establish provenance, not visual correctness, approval or original-artist provenance.
- This fixed 422-image snapshot excludes the forthcoming fresh Grok500 drop, video frames and any uncataloged original files. Missing means not located in this indexed set, not proven absent everywhere.
- Review lanes below are audit classifications, not edits to production review decisions. No image was deleted, regenerated, promoted to Prime or externally sent.
- Side descriptions use viewer-left/right for the shown still unless explicitly character-left. Mirrored or generated images must be checked before translating to anatomical placement.
- A source tattoo cannot be faithfully recovered from covered or cropped geometry by inventing missing lines. Mark uncertainty and request the actual source or a separate reconstruction approval.

RECOVERY PRIORITIES
- Current Hon eye / know, smoking neck blaster and complete chest ship lack verified standalone originals in this indexed set.
- SHIP-SCHEMATIC-REF and SHIP-TATTOO-REF-05 are two existing flat drawings with conflicting geometry; neither has a verified exact current-body match.
- Current Lisan natural-teeth face uses AL, vertical chin GAIB, paired open-mouth creatures and eye-in-sun neck center. SH-18 schematic has a blank sun center and materially different creature geometry.
- Twenty SH JPEG body-outline schematics exist as distinct design options. They have no JPEG alpha channel and are not verified transparent/original source masters.
- Current Lisan left-arm proof exists (SH13); exact clean flat original and hidden wraparound remain unverified.
- Historical bird/cage/racer/slug/Scoundrel, literal-eye, rosette, mask, mechanical emblem, hand-card and varied ship motifs must remain separate recovery records.
- Lisan scene-generated extra hand/knuckle and chest ink is not current-spec approval. Props, jewelry, clothing embroidery, shadows and backdrop eyes are not tattoos.
- Index correction: 255 is REF-yellow-source.jpg; 256 is HD-ARMOR-SWAP-01.jpg. The four-point chest emblem belongs to 256.

CREATIVE / DELIVERY RULES
- currentRecovery: Recover existing distinct artwork and show its exact source/body match. Recovery does not approve historical or Multiverse designs for Prime.
- newCharacters: New characters may invent ink freely. In the same delivery provide a FOUR-option standalone sheet and identify which option matches the body image. Use 10–12 options only when specifically requested.
- existingCharacterChange: Keep current recovery separate from proposals. Any changed design must be labeled a proposed variant, with standalone art and a body-placement comparison.
- delivery: One clean, separately named artwork per distinct retained motif/variant; include source ID/hash, viewer/body side, placement proof, and original/reconstructed/unknown provenance. Transparent PNG or editable source is useful, but do not falsely call a body-photo crop or JPEG schematic an original stencil.
- exclusion: Multiverse and historical artifacts stay separately labeled; removal-queue assets remain provenance-only. No automatic promotion.

ACCOUNTING: 422 image records; 63 motif/variant recovery records; all 422 source hashes and dimensions checked.
This text and its JSON companion contain provenance, not attached image originals.

GROK CARE PACKAGE — HON DOLO / STRICTLY BUSINESS
Package ID: GROK-HD-20261008 | Prepared October 8, 2026

Use this current brief for this handoff. It replaces the old generic twelve-concept request for this work. Dated Grok notes and old tattoo-era pictures remain evidence, not higher-priority instructions. Keep all source files unchanged. These files have been prepared locally; nobody is claiming they are already attached to your session.

READ FIRST
1. requests.json: exact scoped requests, current detail rules and the staged seven-still correction/Caleb maximum; boss discovery is separate.
2. asset_map.json: actual source IDs, exact filenames, SHA256 values, package paths and allowed roles. Confirm the actual attachments are readable. Never map a bare chat number by upload order.
3. panel_plan.txt: five proposed boss beats and four proposed Caleb beats. Caleb's first master is initial; all boss panels wait for boss selection.
4. return_manifest.template.json: complete it for your return ZIP. Null means unknown; hashes must come from actual file bytes.

ADDITIONAL INCLUDED CONTEXT
GROK_DESIGN_INSTRUCTIONS.txt is the current creative rule. review_context/ contains the saved favorite sweep, selective prop requests, detail profiles and boss-discovery plan. audit/ contains the full image-by-image tattoo audit JSON and readable findings, with its own stated inspection limits. The audit covers the existing 422 catalog images at overview level, with its separately recorded individual views; the fresh Grok500 drop is excluded and its intake is pending. These maps cover more images than this package carries: only thirteen input images are attached here. Wider audit records are not proof that those images are available in your session. Ask for an exact missing source by ID and filename when needed. Multiverse findings are history/variant metadata; they do not authorize a Prime redesign or attach the Multiverse armor image. Use the separate boss-discovery ZIP for all three discovery references.

WHAT WE WANT NOW
- REV-HD-001: correct current tattoos/details on REF-cash-source.jpg; preserve cash-counting vest, ship interior, table, money and lighting.
- REV-HD-002: same current-detail correction on REF-coat-source.jpg; preserve the black overcoat, night boarding ramp and atmosphere.
- REV-HD-003: prepare REF-pinstripe-source.jpg for a boss meeting. Keep the navy three-piece, tie/bar, pocket square, watch and polished mood. Correct visible neck/face/grill/jewelry drift; do not expose the covered chest.
- REV-HD-004: preserve REF-saloon-source.jpg fringe outfit and saloon while fixing the malformed visible hip blaster/holster. Return one corrected matching front/three-quarter outfit view plus one hip detail. The prop should read as a coherent fictional sci-fi blaster seated in its holster with sensible visible attachment and overlap. Retain the depicted side for this proof and label it; a permanent hip-side decision is pending.
- SC-BOSS-001: HOLD. Hippo, gecko-frog and original slug are alternatives for boss discovery. Follow boss_discovery_20261008.txt: fifty concepts in five reviewed rounds of ten; select the winner, then front/back/left/right. Only afterward make the pinstripe two-person meeting proof. The earlier Jabba-only/no-roster instruction is superseded.
- SC-CAL-001: one neutral Caleb K reference and one coherent Hon Dolo + Caleb saloon master. Caleb is a new middle-aged white male lawyer, with no supplied real-person likeness. Use HD-SALOON-01-chest-up.jpg as the selected Hon Dolo outfit/bar-scene alpha, not blanket tattoo approval. Friendly, nonviolent interaction, clear separate faces and eyelines.

CURRENT DESIGN / DO NOT MIX ERAS
HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg (HD-DESIGN-01; asset HD-DROP-ef5d59a6402e) is the current visible design reference for these corrections. In its frontal view: eye is under character-right eye (viewer-left); know is under character-left eye (viewer-right); smoke/blaster is on character-left neck (viewer-right). Use the visible ship treatment, gold upper canine caps with the other upper teeth natural, metallic lower grill and current visible jewelry. Match actual placement, angle and size; do not guess a font or mirror sides.

Bird/Jabba tattoos, Chewie lettering, dice, literal third eye and Captain/Falcon wording are excluded from this default pass. A possible future bird variant is an idea held aside, not permission to restore it. The current face reference does not reveal all hands, forearms, back, chest or piercings. Report unknowns. No actor-likeness swap is requested in this package; that is a separate Comfy task.

STENCIL RECOVERY — WHAT THE INVENTORY ACTUALLY FOUND
We received thirteen files named stencil-*: three blaster/chest photo placement sheets and ten retired-era face crops with dice filenames. All thirteen are RGB without alpha. Some dice-named candidates actually show Chewie/bird details, and candidate-4 includes the rejected third eye. Filenames do not prove the artwork content. The combined file named stencil-scoundrel-blaster-ship-sheet.png shows neck/chest crops, not a recovered Scoundrel forearm drawing. Do not call any of those original transparent stencils.

SHIP-TATTOO-REF-05.jpg and SHIP-SCHEMATIC-REF.jpg are real received drawings on white JPEG backgrounds, but depict different geometry/viewpoints. Their presence does not settle the current chest drawing or prove original editable art. Resolve the conflict explicitly; do not merge them automatically.

For ST-HD-EYE, ST-HD-KNOW, ST-HD-BLASTER and ST-HD-SHIP: recover genuine standalone source art if available. Return exact original plus transparent PNG and flat black-on-white exports where possible. Include actual front/left/right placement evidence, labeling character-side and viewer-side. A crop is derived_crop with parent hash/bounds, not source art. If the original does not exist, report original_missing. A later reconstruction must be explicitly named proposed_reconstruction, traceable to a source, and left for review; no new tracing/generation is in this recovery pass. Do not invent hidden anatomy or exact real-world dimensions.

REC-HD-ORIGINALS: try to recover exact originals #101, #103, #107 and #206, plus #112/#116/#117/#121 and #152/#154 if recoverable. They were conversational references, not verified numbered files in our drop. Do not relabel a new recreation as the missing original. #101/#103 tattoo history remains historical. Report forearm Scoundrel and right-hand Leigh/card source gaps rather than filling them from imagination.

STORY / AUDIO
The greedy smuggler eventually pays the price for love. The early money/boss beats build the irony. The remembered Caleb cue, "That's my dog dipped in flavor, Caleb K", is a proposed approximate cue absent from the verified lyric master. Do not insert it, assign timing or make him speak it. Return silent stills and optional motion notes; the real song is added later. No subtitles, lyric lettering, dialogue or lip-sync in these proofs.

CREATIVE FREEDOM / COMPANION ART
New character discovery may invent tattoos, piercings, missing limbs and other distinctive features without a permission-first gate. Every new tattoo arrives with a FOUR-OPTION standalone design sheet in the SAME DELIVERY, matching option identified; label derived reconstruction honestly. Expand to 10-12 only when Ziggy asks. Existing Prime correction tasks still preserve their established detail map. Recovering existing artwork is separate from creative design. See GROK_DESIGN_INSTRUCTIONS.txt.

BOUNDED ORDER / QUALITY GATE
Start with REV-HD-001 and review detail drift before the other corrections. Then finish REV-HD-002/003/004 plus the hip detail. The correction/Caleb batch has seven initial character/scene/detail stills: four revisions, one hip detail, Caleb neutral and Caleb master. SC-BOSS-001 is held until the separate boss discovery produces a selected winner. First boss discovery round has ten single character proofs only, plus required tattoo sheets if tattoos are invented; pause for feedback before each later round. No fifty four-view sets. Additional coverage follows accepted first masters. No unbounded retries.

RETURN ZIP — SINGLE ROOT, EXACT FILENAMES
GROK-HD-20261008_return_v001.zip
  GROK-HD-20261008_return_v001/
    RETURN_MANIFEST.json
    QA_NOTES.txt
    00_CHARACTER_REFS/CALEB-K_REF_v001.png
    01_REVISIONS/REV-HD-001_v001.png
    01_REVISIONS/REV-HD-002_v001.png
    01_REVISIONS/REV-HD-003_v001.png
    01_REVISIONS/REV-HD-004_v001.png
    02_SCENES/BOSS/BOSS-P01_v001.png [HOLD until boss selection; do not include a dummy file]
    02_SCENES/CALEB/CAL-P01_v001.png
    03_DETAILS/PROP-HD-HIP_v001.png
    03_DETAILS/ST-HD-EYE/ [actual original/exports/placement evidence, if recovered]
    03_DETAILS/ST-HD-KNOW/ [same]
    03_DETAILS/ST-HD-BLASTER/ [same]
    03_DETAILS/ST-HD-SHIP/ [same]
    04_RECOVERED_ORIGINALS/ [unchanged original filenames, if recovered]

List every actual returned file in RETURN_MANIFEST.json, with request_id, source_asset_id, exact source filename/hash, output path/hash, region, preserved/changed details and status. Compute new hashes from files; leave null + not_computed if unavailable. No empty dummy image files. Missing originals belong in request_results with original_missing, not a fabricated file. For new outputs, record prompt/model/seed only if actually known. Keep all results needs_user_review; don't mark them approved on our behalf. If you split the ZIP for size, use part01ofNN names and one master manifest listing each part/file. Preserve file names and IDs across parts.

READY-TO-PASTE COVER
Grok, read START_HERE.txt and GROK_DESIGN_INSTRUCTIONS.txt, reconcile actual files with asset_map.json, and use the current correction and scene scope. Preserve selected Prime outfits/settings and current LOCK-FACE details; recover real tattoo source art honestly. The separate boss brief replaces the old Jabba-only assumption: begin with BOSS-001..010, review each ten toward fifty, select a winner, then four views and a meeting proof. Creative new-character features are welcome; every invented tattoo comes with a same-delivery four-option standalone design sheet, matching option identified. Only expand a tattoo to 10-12 if Ziggy asks. Return actual files and manifests, no dialogue, lyric retiming or invented source claims. All outputs remain for user review.

assets.title: Boss and Caleb panel plans
assets.text:
HON DOLO — PROPOSED BOSS AND CALEB COVERAGE
Package GROK-HD-20261008. These are semantic scene beats, not new fixed song timecodes. Keep the existing lyric master and shot_plan unchanged. Stills first; Flow is a later motion candidate, not a promise of preserved details.

SHARED SHOT RULES
16:9 compositions, one clear beat per panel, readable facial scale and distinct silhouettes. Maintain one meeting layout and eyeline axis across coverage; record camera side instead of accidentally mirroring the tattoos. Show only supported body details. Natural hands separated from faces/props. No on-image text, spoken dialogue or lip-sync. Use exact accepted return image IDs for later Flow attachments. A wide shot does not automatically supply a reliable face reference.

BOSS SLOT
Boss discovery now compares hippo, gecko-frog and original slug directions across five rounds of ten. No winner is selected. All boss interaction panels below are HOLD proposals until selection; the former Jabba-only assumption is superseded. See boss_discovery_20261008.txt.

SC-BOSS-001 / PINSTRIPE MEETING — FIVE PANEL PROPOSALS
Base wardrobe: REF-pinstripe-source.jpg, corrected through REV-HD-003. Current details: HD-DESIGN-01. The office/penthouse luxury mood can meet the selected boss setting, but a set redesign is a proposal, not a source-preservation claim.

BOSS-P01 — The appointment [HOLD UNTIL BOSS SELECTED]
Medium-wide two-shot: suited Hon Dolo image-left, the selected boss image-right on a low dais or coherent seated position, both readable and turned toward each other across a small open negotiation space. Dolo has confident posture; the power imbalance comes from blocking, not threats. Avoid adding extra named cast. Keep hands resting neutrally. Return this master first; selected identity must match its accepted reference.
Flow candidate after acceptance: slow push-in with a small Dolo head turn; no dialogue.

BOSS-P02 — Terms [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Medium two-shot on the same axis. Dolo makes one small open-palmed business gesture; boss listens. Keep both faces in view, stable furniture and the pinstripe silhouette. No new money exchange or signed document invented as a story fact.
Motion candidate: gesture settles, small glance to boss.

BOSS-P03 — The calculation [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Dolo-dominant medium shot with boss recognizable deeper in frame. A restrained smug smile communicates "strictly business" while his posture remains alert. Grill and neck lettering stay readable. No exaggerated mouth performance.
Motion candidate: brief glance down then back up.

BOSS-P04 — Boss reaction [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Boss-dominant view, Dolo in a clear shoulder/three-quarter foreground relationship. Preserve the meeting axis. Use only body portions supported by the chosen boss master; no invented unseen limbs or face redesign.
Motion candidate: small reaction with Dolo almost still.

BOSS-P05 — Business concluded [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Return to a wider two-shot. Dolo angles toward the exit but keeps enough face visible for identity; boss stays in place. This is an ambiguous end to the meeting, not proof of paid debt or a changed plot outcome. Do not expose an invented back tattoo.
Motion candidate: one small turn/step after proof, no complex walk choreography.

SC-CAL-001 / WESTERN SALOON — FOUR PANEL PROPOSALS
Base: HD-SALOON-01-chest-up.jpg is the user's chosen outfit/bar alpha. Use REF-saloon-source.jpg for environment and the corrected REV-HD-004 prop/context. Caleb K is a distinct middle-aged white male lawyer, no supplied real-person likeness. First return one neutral three-quarter or frontal portrait, CALEB-K_REF_v001.png, with clear face and ordinary restrained lawyer wardrobe; creative details are allowed as proposals; any new tattoo needs its same-delivery four-option design sheet, and no new feature is an automatic lock.

The remembered cue "That's my dog dipped in flavor, Caleb K" is approximate and is not in the verified Strictly Business lyric master. Keep its song alignment pending. Do not turn it into spoken dialogue or add it to the song.

CAL-P01 — My lawyer at the bar [INITIAL TWO-PERSON PROOF]
Medium two-shot in the warm wooden saloon, Hon Dolo in his fringe look and Caleb seated or standing beside him at the bar. Familiar amused recognition, both faces clearly readable, hands resting separately. Caleb looks like his neutral reference. No drinks or paperwork need to become required story props. Nonviolent, no drawn weapon; if the hip is visible, use the corrected holster.
Flow candidate after acceptance: friendly nod, a tiny shoulder turn and subtle camera drift. No lip-sync.

CAL-P02 — Recognition [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Same side of the bar and same eyeline axis. Dolo gestures toward Caleb with one small open hand, no face-touching or tangled handshake. Caleb gives a restrained amused response. Keep both expressions legible.

CAL-P03 — Caleb's reaction [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Caleb-dominant medium with Dolo visibly present at the edge/foreground. A knowing lawyer's look is enough; no invented spoken line, legal document text or new criminal plot.

CAL-P04 — Shared laugh / settled beat [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Balanced two-shot, a brief relaxed laugh or smile, then settled posture. Keep mouth movement modest for a future visual-only clip. Same clothes, hands, jewelry, prop side and bar geography as the accepted master.

REVIEW BEFORE EXPANSION
Check each face against its assigned identity reference, then current eye/know/blaster/grill and visible piercings, then outfit fabric, prop attachment, body-side labels, scale and eyelines. A selected scene alpha is not approval of every tattoo visible on it. Return mismatches with source/output IDs. Do not request full 360 sets for every look; add only the particular three-quarter view that a later shot demonstrably needs.

3. PACKAGE_MAP.json identifies the supplied image and role; FLOW_INTAKE.txt explains the planned Characters/Images split. Outfit and setting references remain separate from identity. Add from project selects existing assets; Upload supplies local files. Bind actual filenames and IDs after upload, never guessed picture numbers. Keep Settings > Confirm before generating set to Always for planning. The Agent can generate batches, organize, rename or delete assets; state the scope. 5. Paste FLOW_BRIEF.txt, relevant PROJECT_BRIEF.txt context, the selected PACKAGE_MAP.json role entries and the planning message below together. Attach the actual image through the UI. Stable instructions explain how we work; roles explain the attachments; EXPERIMENT.txt supplies this one task. Do not upload every historical reference.

OPTIONAL FIRST AGENT MESSAGE
Plan only; do not generate, rename or delete anything. Read the supplied briefs and selected role entries. Confirm which actual images you can see. HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg is our sole first-test character reference. Propose one 2.1 still using FLOW-HD-STILL-001 from EXPERIMENT.txt, preserving face, tattoos, grillz, jewelry, outfit and framing. Keep broader scenes and audio for later. Report missing inputs and present the prompt/settings for review.

Our proposed baseline is one 2.1 still after sorting and actual attachment verification. PANHANDLER NOVA — CFA RETURN, OCTOBER 8, 2026

Ziggy now has a separate CFA Creative Studio at https://algaib.streamlit.app/ with source in apps/creative_studio/app.py. The local visual library remains the production review surface. Hon Dolo / Strictly Business and Lisan Al Gaib / Meta Mirror are separate projects.

The current work adds Ziggy's Corner / Mission Control with prepared Grok, Gemini, Flow and Panhandler handoffs. Stars are a broad shortlist. An independent export basket selects a smaller package. Review choices distinguish keep, needs fixes and mark for removal; shot plans name their destination. Local browser state is not automatic repository persistence: use a chosen review file or JSON export. Hosted reviews live in the user's session and need export/import. No button sends to another provider or deletes the original media.

Three exact pixel crops preserve Luke, Leia and Han from the original group photo. Their parent hash and crop bounds are in casting/likeness_crops/manifest.json. These are separate likeness targets for a possible Comfy experiment; they do not redefine Hon Dolo's tattoos or identity anchor.

Grok's current handoff is projects/hon_dolo_strictly_business/handoffs/grok_20261008/START_HERE.txt. It preserves selected outfits/scenes while asking for current detail corrections, a coherent holstered sci-fi prop, and first two-character proofs for a boss meeting and Caleb K saloon scene. Boss discovery now compares the original slug, hippo and gecko-frog directions. Fifty single proofs are planned as five reviewed rounds of ten, followed by front/back/left/right of the selected winner. SC-BOSS-001 waits for that selection; the former Jabba-only assumption is superseded. The remembered Caleb lyric is not in the verified current lyric master, so timing and words remain open.

Measured source finding: thirteen stencil-named helpers are opaque photo crops/placement sheets, not verified transparent originals. Some dice-named files depict other retired details. Two received ship drawings disagree in geometry. The handoff requests genuine source recovery and labels missing originals, derived crops and any future reconstruction separately. It maps exact source IDs, filenames, hashes and regions and supplies a return manifest.

Flow's current UI has Images, Characters, Avatars and Uploads. Selected identity references belong in a character intake; outfits, settings and composition have separate limited roles. We are preparing a small character proof after Ziggy finishes sorting. No Flow upload, generation or character acceptance is recorded. Model capability documentation is evidence for choosing a test, not a measured quality result.

BOUNDED TEACHING RETURN
Use existing reference-role, controlled-comparison and export/persistence lessons. Add these examples only where they help: a liked outfit can still need tattoo repair; a filename does not establish the artwork's role; an exported selection list is not a media ZIP; an exact crop is not a generated recreation; reference availability, actual upload, generation and acceptance are distinct. Preserve the existing Pan schemas and completed curriculum. Link CFA evidence rather than copying the full media library. Return adopted changes through Help/CFA_FEEDBACK.md. CFA retains production ownership; this prepared brief does not claim Panhandler Nova has read it.

COLLABORATORS WORKSPACE — FOLLOW-UP
Ziggy asks Panhandler Nova to add a Collaborators navigation area on the Pan app: begin with ComfyUI, then provide the explanatory how-tos and whys for Grok, Gemini and Flow where appropriate. CFA’s Collaborators area remains operational: source assets, actual graphs, outputs, observed defects and the next action. One media record appears through both its project and the collaborator workspace; avoid separate master copies.

The soundtrack replacement output is outputs/hon_dolo_audio_replace_v001_local_preview.mp4: local stream-copy picture preservation is measured; the related Cloud graph is saved/server-converted but not executed. Mouth sync is a separate unexecuted candidate. Motion, depth and edge tests preserve their actual failure/acceptance states in collaborators/comfy_workflows.json. Reuse the existing video_handoff lesson for native frames/audio assembly; do not teach the audio swap as lip-sync.

New review teaching: Multiverse Dolo is an explicit creative lane and is excluded from Prime collaborator packages by default. Working-reference requests have an approval scope and enter a sweep; a favorite is not a complete-character approval. Save/export carries the browser review state to CFA. Preparing a sweep does not invoke an agent or delete originals. Creative discovery may invent tattoos, piercings, missing limbs and other character features without an approval-first gate. Every new tattoo arrives with a FOUR-OPTION standalone design sheet in the same delivery, identifying the option matching its body proof. Label a later reconstruction honestly. Expand an intriguing motif to 10-12 only when Ziggy asks. Existing Prime preservation tasks still protect current details. Recovering missing original art remains separate from new design. This supersedes the earlier blanket stencil-first rule.

Bounded Pan task: link the new Collaborators area to existing lessons, add these state/preservation examples, and return adopted pages plus checks in Help/CFA_FEEDBACK.md. Do not copy production media or rewrite CFA workflows. This is a manual handoff, not a claim that another Nova has read or implemented it.


LATEST REVIEW AND FLOW SOURCE CORRECTIONS
The saved review was read without modification: 35 favorites and two user-origin records were validated against actual IDs, hashes and disk bytes. Four stale catalog-origin records were ignored. See projects/hon_dolo_strictly_business/feedback/review_sweep_20261008.json and the read-only review_intake_plan.py. This is selection precedence, not an assertion that distinct files have identical content. Original bytes and provenance remain.

Flow experiment 002 is now prepared from the retained 41-second source: frames 244-387, six seconds, 1280 x 720 at 24 fps, re-encoded H.264 with no audio. All 144 excerpt frames decode; quarter-second samples and full-size beginning/middle/end were inspected; no scene trigger above 0.18 appears inside the excerpt. A source montage being longer does not establish better quality. One subtle lighting edit is proposed; no Flow upload, generation, provider cost or acceptance is claimed. CFA's Collaborators workspace owns actual files, scoped briefs, source/output hashes, workflow graphs, upload mappings, review choices and experiment results. Panhandler's requested Collaborators area teaches the how and why: reference roles, creative discovery versus preservation, honest artwork lineage, finite review rounds, source correction precedence, media export versus selection metadata, and motion/audio validation. Link CFA evidence rather than duplicate its masters. Start with existing Comfy lessons and add Grok/Gemini/Flow explanatory connections where useful. Preserve completed curricula and schemas; no production execution or Pan app change is performed by this return. Record adopted teaching pages and checks in Help/CFA_FEEDBACK.md. Manual ledger synchronization is not an automatic message or proof of Nova's adoption.
