Do not add tattoos, jewelry, people, props or readable text.

Fixed medium camera, same side of the counter, same aspect ratio and set geometry. No cuts, zoom, mirror flip, wardrobe change, reframing, loop or fade. Subtle natural breathing and believable hand motion. No speech, singing or music; quiet room tone only if sound is generated. Return one video and stop.
END SHARED PROMPT

This is also TURN_01 in GEMINI_10_TURNS.txt: generate it once. A passing Gemini benchmark take can serve as the continuation parent. Record the actual output facts in RUN_PLAN.json before starting turn 02. If it ends in a materially different state, reconcile the continuation plan instead of assuming compatibility. The gentle first shot screens identity and instruction-following; it does not by itself prove complex money handling or talking-mouth fidelity.

REVIEW CARD — SAME QUESTIONS FOR EVERY RESULT
Watch the original in normal-speed playback, then inspect the start, middle, end, finger movement and any visible defect. Use neutral review labels A/B/C/... before revealing provider names where practical. Native watermarks may make blinding incomplete; retain them and note the limit.
Score each supported category 0-4: 0 unusable/broken, 1 major defects, 2 mixed/repair needed, 3 usable with minor defects, 4 clean for this shot. Use N/A for a feature not exposed; do not infer grill fidelity from closed lips or full-body continuity from a medium shot.
- Identity and scoped details: face/hair, lettering, visible tattoo shapes, rings and visible teeth.
- Hands and objects: anatomy, finger movement, four stable rectangular credits and consistent scale/contact if any occurs.
- Temporal continuity: flicker, morphing, duplication, disappearing pieces, wardrobe/set drift.
- Instruction-following: specified gaze/hand sequence, fixed camera, one person, no invented words/cuts.
- Cinematic usefulness: readable intention, natural performance, usable beginning/end and visual quality at native size.
For every defect, record the time/frame, severity and source comparison. A serious identity substitution or impossible hand/credit event fails reusable-shot acceptance even if the clip looks beautiful. Keep the individual scores and Ziggy's preference; do not hide tradeoffs in one grand winner number.

Also record actual duration/resolution/FPS; requested versus delivered output count; request/queue/completion times where observable; credits/currency and whether estimated or actually attributed; retries; operator effort; download integrity; and real model/version/graph evidence. Subscription credits are not automatically comparable dollars. Unknown values remain unknown. A new generation failure is an outcome to retain, not a reason to quietly buy another attempt.

CONTINUATION IS A SEPARATE CAPABILITY TEST
After the short-shot screen, test one continuation for a selected route using its actual passing parent and TURN_02's count-the-four-credits action. Require growing duration, retained earlier sequence, a coherent join and the complete cumulative output. Record original duration, added duration, parent lineage, prefix comparison and defects. Editing, appending and external stitching receive different labels.
Gemini's existing ten-turn package remains available if the continuation test passes. It does not authorize a ten-turn chain for every contender. A Gemini baseline reused as TURN_01 leaves at most nine further calls in that existing chain; do not count or generate it again.
Flow currently documents extension through Veo 3.1 Lite for eligible eight-second Veo 3.1 clips, even when the parent was Fast/Quality. That is a mixed-model chain and must be labeled. Omni editing is not proof of append-only extension. Grok API extension support does not prove the consumer interface exposes it. Do not invent a Comfy extension socket or claim concatenating outputs is native continuation.

LEARN SPECIALTIES BY SCENE AND DETAIL
Use the capability map in BENCHMARK_PLAN.json alongside the existing run records. Every cell starts untested, with no provider assigned as the best choice. Image and video findings stay separate. Grow this map through actual storyboard work instead of generating every scene with every model at once.
- Opening transaction: the current single-person ship-counter proof, restrained expression and hand movement. It does not establish bar-scene, walking, crowd or talking-mouth ability.
- One person seated at a bar: face/hair, posture, outfit, atmosphere, glass/hand contact and visible teeth/grill when actually exposed.
- One person moving: face/hair/detail preservation while body or camera moves. Native continuation receives its own prefix/join checks.
- Two people interacting: distinct identities, eyelines, contact, which hands belong to whom and ownership of props.
- Crowd: foreground identity, occlusion, duplicated people and background consistency.
Record hair SHAPE/texture and hair TEMPORAL preservation separately. Do the same for facial identity, tattoos, grill/teeth, jewelry, hands, object count/contact and environment. A hidden grill is not observable, not a passing grill test. A static image cannot pass temporal checks.
A recommendation should say what worked, for which scene/camera/motion/configuration, with run IDs, sample count, failures and uncertainty. One strong bar take can make that model a candidate for similar shots; one weak group take does not justify a permanent ban on groups. Retest only when the next production decision needs it. Model/version changes may invalidate an old preference.
Later we can explicitly test a mixed workflow, such as ChatGPT still -> Flow animation -> Comfy finishing. Keep that new pipeline's evidence separate from the common-frame baseline. Review every handoff for preserved identity/details, since combining individually strong tools does not guarantee a strong chain. Return useful measured routing lessons to Notebook0 through the existing workflow; project-specific art/approval remains local.

MY / NOVA'S ENTRY
ChatGPT is included directly for still images. Its native video entry is conditional: this Codex session currently has no connected standalone video-generation tool, and no ChatGPT account video mode has been verified. If an accessible native route is verified when we run, give it the SAME chosen frame/prompt, identify its actual model and include one take. A still, slideshow, or Comfy output does not count as that entry.
Nova directs and operates the runs. A Nova-directed Comfy variant can later test whether one justified workflow change improves a baseline, with the actual backend and extra effort disclosed. It would be a workflow/tuning comparison, not a fifth independent model wearing a Codex label.
The documented OpenAI Sora 2 / Sora 2 Pro / Videos API shutdown date was September 24, 2026. As of this plan, that API is not an available fifth lane. Old model and guide pages remaining online do not establish availability. No API keys or new accounts were requested.
Source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations

OTHER CONTENDERS / CIVITAI
Consider a genuinely different video family only after this first screen answers something useful. Favor a compatible existing Comfy template over another account or duplicated infrastructure. The saved MiniMax H3 discovery is a candidate for a later Comfy comparison, not verified current compatibility. A documented Kling route is another candidate if it supplies a useful distinct capability; see the dated source notes in BENCHMARK_PLAN.json.
Civitai can supply particular models/adapters/workflows through the existing intake. Record the actual base model, adapter, compatible architecture and effective graph. Merely replacing an example image does not prove that a package can preserve Dolo, and another storefront is not automatically another model. Keep a decorated/tuned recipe separate from the plain baseline. No registration, model import, package execution or account upload is needed to prepare this comparison.

SAVED COMFY BASELINE AND EXISTING LESSONS
Problem-to-recipe: workflows/README.md#choose-by-problem, "Animate an existing still into a new short shot."
Saved workflow: https://cloud.comfy.org/#bfe78175-2366-4a28-bb76-518c89bef525
Record: workflows/hon_dolo_motion_v001.record.json; editor: workflows/hon_dolo_motion_v001.editor.json; executed graph: workflows/hon_dolo_motion_v001.executed.api.json. Paths and hashes are in BENCHMARK_PLAN.json. The old 960x512 / 24 fps / 97-frame motion test completed with eye/smile drift in sampled frames and no final acceptance. Its actual ratio was 15:8 despite a widescreen selector label. This is evidence that the old recipe ran, not an eight-second, 16:9 benchmark result or current Cloud compatibility.
The saved graph uses intrinsic latent x2 refinement. Preserve and disclose the model's required internal stages; "no upscale" here excludes optional output finishing, not a hidden removal of the saved model's normal generation stages. Prefer the recovered editor over the upstream snapshot's stale embedded prompt. Do not carry its old source frame or duration into the new run.
Use ../Pan_Handlers/Help/content/video_routes.py (image_to_video), guides/sampling_lab.py and guides/workflow_decision.py through CFA_TUTORIAL_LEDGER.md / FILE_MAP.md, relative to the CFA checkout. An old zero-credit API-node estimate was not proof of free native GPU execution. Model weights stay in Cloud; necessary native media and records stay on D:.

CURRENT SOURCE NOTES / LIVE-ACCOUNT LIMITS

GEMINI — ONE OPENING SCENE, UP TO TEN DEPENDENT TURNS
CURRENT DENTAL / HEAD-REFERENCE UPDATE — OCTOBER 9
The user has selected exactly FOUR gold upper caps: both lateral incisors plus
both SHORT canines. The two central upper incisors and all other uppers remain
natural white; keep the lower silver/chrome grill, two plain lip hoops, and
original nostril placement (one hoop per nostril, no septum substitution).
The old two-canines-only A reference is still recorded below as source history.
Before either still-generation lane, receive and inspect a compatible corrected
primary reference, then replace A and reconcile its exact name/hash and prompt
in this package. Current prompts are drafts, not ready to send with old teeth.
Before any video lane, select one new scene frame matching the current design
and use its same exact bytes across all lanes. Do not claim pixel-preservation
of an old mouth while changing its tooth map. Older originals stay unchanged.
Reuse the accepted head library across outfits, selecting relevant views rather
than attaching every head. Mouth macros remain separate close-detail authority.
Shared method (relative to Comfy): projects/collaborators/character_head_reference_standard.txt.
Expected drop: ../../head_library_20261009/expected_intake.json.
This update changes no job counts and performs no generation.

Prepared plan, not executed. Use one chosen conversation and the actual selected shared benchmark frame. Do not paste all ten requests at once. "Verified" below means inspected as fit to continue this prototype, not a new canonical approval.

TURN 01 is the exact shared prompt from BENCHMARK.txt. Reuse a passing Gemini benchmark take; do not submit it twice. It now targets eight seconds for the common comparison. The ten-turn count is unchanged.

BEFORE TURN 01
First verify the selected frame reflects the current four-gold design, then identify that exact frame by filename/hash in RUN_PLAN.json. Attach that file directly in the generation composer; a notebook text source or a path string is not proof that the image is available as generation input. The three original Grok references are recorded separately; avoid flooding Gemini with conflicting historical pictures. The common benchmark uses this one frame only. Additional identity inputs belong to a separately labeled tuned-workflow round.

Check the mode without generating: can it use this image, offer the eight-second benchmark target, and later CONTINUE the result rather than merely regenerate/edit it? Record what the interface actually offers. Official multi-turn editing documentation does not guarantee prefix preservation. Do not silently switch to Flow, an API, a paid new service or a stitching route.

SCENE CONTRACT FOR EVERY TURN
One Dolo, seated at the same ship counter, same studded vest/chain, current face/hair/tattoos/grill/rings. One implied customer offscreen, no visible extra person or extra hand. Four identical warm-gold luminous rectangular credits, no banknotes/coins. Medium fixed camera on the same side, same aspect ratio, light, set geometry and object scale; no cuts, reframing, zoom, mirror flip or wardrobe change. Restrained expressions, believable hand contact. No dialogue, singing, generated music, captions or new readable screens. Use only optional quiet room tone. Lyrics express the story beat; exact song audio and lip sync are separate later work.

OPERATOR GATE AFTER EVERY TURN
Inspect normal-speed video and listen to its actual audio; examine hands/credits, face, lettering, mouth/rings and the join. Record dimensions, FPS/timebase if measurable, duration, frame count if measurable, filename/hash and observed defects. Unknown stays unknown. The next turn starts from the ACTUAL final pose, not merely the requested pose. If it materially missed this turn's end state or changes the planned blocking, stop and revise the plan instead of blindly sending the next card.

For turns 02-10, compare the returned native file against the previous verified parent: duration must grow, earlier content must remain in order without truncation/loop/retiming, and the join must be coherent. Review the full prefix at normal speed plus aligned samples and the join frame-by-frame. If exact decoded frame/timestamp hashes agree, record exact preservation; if the provider re-encodes them, do not call the prefix pixel-identical. Record the measured differences and visual assessment. If it rewrites material, only returns a disconnected suffix, or cannot be inspected/downloaded, STOP. Do not label regeneration or local concatenation a successful native extension. Keep the last verified parent and report the limitation.

These prepared limits are not execution or spending authorization. During an authorized run, Nova may inspect each returned take and proceed autonomously within the agreed limits. A passing routine check does not need another user confirmation; pause for an actual failure, missing capability or unresolved creative choice. Ten prompts is a maximum route, not a promised duration or compulsory ten-run batch. Stop early if the opening beat is complete. No automatic retries or extra rounds. Select the next block only after the gate passes.

TURN 01 — Create the short opening proof
Required parent: BENCHMARK_FRAME_SELECTED.
PASTE:
Animate the attached selected starting frame as one continuous eight-second opening shot for the Strictly Business transaction. Keep the same Hon Dolo, studded armor vest, substantial chain, ship counter, lighting and camera placement. He is the only visible person; the customer stays offscreen near the lens. Exactly four matching warm-gold luminous rectangular credit pieces lie separately on the counter. No banknotes or coins.

Dolo looks from the credits toward the implied customer, gives a restrained businesslike half-smile, then lowers his gaze toward the money. His character-right index finger moves naturally to hover just above the first piece, ready to count. End poised there. The credits remain still and separate; do not complete the count or transaction yet. Keep both hands and their plausible anatomy visible.

Preserve the starting frame's face, curly hair, skin, lowercase cheek lettering, smoking blaster on his character-left neck, visible chest artwork and piercings. If teeth become visible, keep exactly four gold upper caps at the two lateral incisors and two SHORT canines; the two central upper incisors and all other uppers remain natural white. Preserve the lower silver/chrome grill, two plain lower-lip hoops and original nostril placement (one hoop per nostril, no septum substitution). Teeth may naturally disappear behind closed lips. Do not add tattoos, jewelry, people, props or readable text.

Fixed medium camera, same side of the counter, same aspect ratio and set geometry. No cuts, zoom, mirror flip, wardrobe change, reframing, loop or fade. Subtle natural breathing and believable hand motion. No speech, singing or music; quiet room tone only if sound is generated. Return one video and stop.
Check before the next turn: Poised to start the first count; all four credit pieces remain in the original row.

TURN 02 — First count — the actual continuation test
Required parent: TURN_01_VERIFIED.
PASTE:
Continue only the immediately preceding VERIFIED cumulative video, from its actual last pose. Append the new action after that ending while leaving every earlier event in its original order and timing. Return the complete native cumulative video, not a replacement or a disconnected suffix. Keep the scene contract. If this mode cannot append without rewriting the earlier material, stop and explain the limitation without generating an alternative. NEW ACTION ONLY: Dolo uses the poised index finger to touch each of the same four credit pieces once, in row order, without picking them up. He makes four distinct, unhurried touches, then withdraws the fingertip slightly. The four pieces remain separate and stationary. Add only the shortest natural continuation needed; no filler to meet a total duration. Return one result and stop for review.
Check before the next turn: First count completed; same four pieces and same seated blocking.

TURN 03 — Strictly business
Required parent: TURN_02_VERIFIED.
PASTE:
Continue only the immediately preceding VERIFIED cumulative video, from its actual last pose. Append the new action after that ending while leaving every earlier event in its original order and timing. Return the complete native cumulative video, not a replacement or a disconnected suffix. Keep the scene contract. If this mode cannot append without rewriting the earlier material, stop and explain the limitation without generating an alternative. NEW ACTION ONLY: Dolo raises his gaze from the counted row toward the same off-camera customer. Hold a brief skeptical look and a subtle head tilt, conveying that the price is firm. His hands stay beside the same four pieces. No spoken words or lip-synced performance. Add only the shortest natural continuation needed; no filler to meet a total duration. Return one result and stop for review.
Check before the next turn: Gaze toward customer; money unchanged.

TURN 04 — Count it twice
Required parent: TURN_03_VERIFIED.
PASTE:
Continue only the immediately preceding VERIFIED cumulative video, from its actual last pose. Append the new action after that ending while leaving every earlier event in its original order and timing. Return the complete native cumulative video, not a replacement or a disconnected suffix. Keep the scene contract. If this mode cannot append without rewriting the earlier material, stop and explain the limitation without generating an alternative. NEW ACTION ONLY: Dolo looks down and checks the SAME four credit pieces a second time, touching each once in the reverse row order. This is a recount of existing money, not a second payment. End with his finger lifted clear; no extra pieces appear. Add only the shortest natural continuation needed; no filler to meet a total duration. Return one result and stop for review.
Check before the next turn: Second count completed; four pieces total, unchanged identity/set.

TURN 05 — Make the offered payment neat
Required parent: TURN_04_VERIFIED.
PASTE:
Continue only the immediately preceding VERIFIED cumulative video, from its actual last pose. Append the new action after that ending while leaving every earlier event in its original order and timing. Return the complete native cumulative video, not a replacement or a disconnected suffix. Keep the scene contract. If this mode cannot append without rewriting the earlier material, stop and explain the limitation without generating an alternative. NEW ACTION ONLY: Dolo gently nudges the edges of the same four pieces into one straight, evenly spaced row. Keep each piece visible, with only small sliding movements on the counter; do not stack, transform or replace them. End with hands relaxed beside the row. Add only the shortest natural continuation needed; no filler to meet a total duration. Return one result and stop for review.
Check before the next turn: Four pieces aligned; no teleporting or duplication.

TURN 06 — Fuel costs extra
Required parent: TURN_05_VERIFIED.
PASTE:
Continue only the immediately preceding VERIFIED cumulative video, from its actual last pose. Append the new action after that ending while leaving every earlier event in its original order and timing. Return the complete native cumulative video, not a replacement or a disconnected suffix. Keep the scene contract. If this mode cannot append without rewriting the earlier material, stop and explain the limitation without generating an alternative. NEW ACTION ONLY: Dolo glances once toward the existing dim fuel-status area established in the starting frame, then back toward the customer. If no such indicator was established, glance toward the same fixed console instead; do not invent a new display now. Raise one index finger briefly as a matter-of-fact fee reminder. Credits remain untouched. Add only the shortest natural continuation needed; no filler to meet a total duration. Return one result and stop for review.
Check before the next turn: One-finger fee gesture settled; four credits unchanged.

TURN 07 — Payment before passage
Required parent: TURN_06_VERIFIED.
PASTE:
Continue only the immediately preceding VERIFIED cumulative video, from its actual last pose. Append the new action after that ending while leaving every earlier event in its original order and timing. Return the complete native cumulative video, not a replacement or a disconnected suffix. Keep the scene contract. If this mode cannot append without rewriting the earlier material, stop and explain the limitation without generating an alternative. NEW ACTION ONLY: Dolo lowers the raised finger. He uses the flat side of one hand to draw the same four aligned credit pieces a short distance toward his side of the counter, keeping them visible and separate. The pieces move by contact, not by disappearing beneath his hand. Stop once the row is closer to him. Add only the shortest natural continuation needed; no filler to meet a total duration. Return one result and stop for review.
Check before the next turn: Payment drawn closer to Dolo; all four pieces visible.

TURN 08 — You are buying a ride
Required parent: TURN_07_VERIFIED.
PASTE:
Continue only the immediately preceding VERIFIED cumulative video, from its actual last pose. Append the new action after that ending while leaving every earlier event in its original order and timing. Return the complete native cumulative video, not a replacement or a disconnected suffix. Keep the scene contract. If this mode cannot append without rewriting the earlier material, stop and explain the limitation without generating an alternative. NEW ACTION ONLY: With the other hand, Dolo gives one small directional gesture toward the existing offscreen entrance, granting passage only after taking the payment. His seat, torso and camera position stay fixed. No new customer, doorway view, location or cut appears. The four credits remain where turn 07 left them. Add only the shortest natural continuation needed; no filler to meet a total duration. Return one result and stop for review.
Check before the next turn: Small passage gesture completed; transaction geography unchanged.

TURN 09 — Nice try
Required parent: TURN_08_VERIFIED.
PASTE:
Continue only the immediately preceding VERIFIED cumulative video, from its actual last pose. Append the new action after that ending while leaving every earlier event in its original order and timing. Return the complete native cumulative video, not a replacement or a disconnected suffix. Keep the scene contract. If this mode cannot append without rewriting the earlier material, stop and explain the limitation without generating an alternative. NEW ACTION ONLY: Dolo rests both hands near his side of the counter and gives the customer a brief knowing half-smile, as if dismissing an attempt to get a free extra. Keep the mouth restrained; when teeth show, preserve exactly four gold upper caps (both lateral incisors and both SHORT canines), two natural white central incisors and natural other uppers, the lower silver/chrome grill, two plain lip hoops and original nostril placement. He is still mercenary, not suddenly heroic. Add only the shortest natural continuation needed; no filler to meet a total duration. Return one result and stop for review.
Check before the next turn: Restrained smile settles; four credits still on his side.

TURN 10 — Close the opening beat
Required parent: TURN_09_VERIFIED.
PASTE:
Continue only the immediately preceding VERIFIED cumulative video, from its actual last pose. Append the new action after that ending while leaving every earlier event in its original order and timing. Return the complete native cumulative video, not a replacement or a disconnected suffix. Keep the scene contract. If this mode cannot append without rewriting the earlier material, stop and explain the limitation without generating an alternative. NEW ACTION ONLY: Dolo lets the smile fade to calm confidence and turns his attention slightly toward the ship console without getting up. The four luminous credits remain clearly in frame. Finish with a short natural settle suitable for an editorial cut; do not loop, fade, add text, start a chase, introduce a boss or move into the later rescue story. Add only the shortest natural continuation needed; no filler to meet a total duration. Return one result and stop for review.
Check before the next turn: Stable end pose; opening payment beat complete.

FINAL HANDOFF
After the last passing turn, download/designate ONE longest verified cumulative native MP4, using its actual provider filename in the receipt. Keep the source-frame hash and the chain of parent/output identifiers with actual durations and observations. If only the creation passes, retain it as the initial proof and report continuation blocked. A longer unverified clip does not outrank the last passing one.
Measured parent-versus-candidate checks may require temporary downloads of both files at each step; this plan does not promise download-free verification. Designate only the final passing cumulative take as the permanent master. Avoid redundant permanent exports of every intermediate. Earlier downloads may be retained where needed to compare the prefix or document a failure; never delete or overwrite existing user files. Any later cleanup is a separate explicit operation. Do not publish, send to another collaborator, add a favorite or promote a working reference automatically.

assets.title: Reusable character head standard
assets.text:
CFA CHARACTER HEAD REFERENCE STANDARD

Adopted by Ziggy October 9, 2026. Reuse across projects; character identity stays separate.



THE THREE LINKED REFERENCES

1. HEAD LIBRARY: the selected character identity, hair, face/neck artwork, jewelry and mouth states across useful angles. Use a consistent head-and-shoulders crop, plain black tee or suitable neutral collar, neutral grey background and steady lighting. Keep relevant neck details visible. This is not a cut-off floating head and does not establish unseen rear anatomy.

2. MOUTH DETAIL LIBRARY: close-ups for tooth layout/materials, lips and rings. Match each head to the accepted mouth detail/revision. Macro shots do not replace the whole face or validate speech timing.

3. OUTFIT REFERENCE: one clear full-body hero view per outfit as the default. Link it to the character/head revision and outfit parent. Add garment, accessory or prop angles only when needed; do not repeat the entire head library for every outfit. Gun/no-gun views stay children of one outfit.



MAIN-CHARACTER COVERAGE — CURRENT HON PLAN

50 mouth/expression states from the front.

20 of those states also get four additional views: character-left three-quarter, character-right three-quarter, character-left profile and character-right profile. Describe turn direction explicitly; never use a mirror to fabricate the opposite view.

50 + (20 x 4) = 130 unique head-state/view combinations. The 20 frontal key-state views are already among the 50. Fifty separate mouth close-ups are counted separately, so the planned mouth-plus-head material totals 180 coverage items before outfit images/contact sheets, if both full sets arrive.

Grok also said 150 heads in the live conversation. Reconcile the actual manifest. A second front take can be useful but does not fill an additional required coverage slot; different bytes remain separate takes. Exact duplicates may share one canonical file with aliases.

LATEST PROVIDER EXPANSION: after Ziggy said counts were flexible, Grok proposed looking-up and looking-down views for the 20 key states and called it 190 heads. Keeping the shared fronts once gives 50 + 20*(7-1) = 170 unique head views; 190 exports would include 20 repeated front slots. Record 40 proposed pitch-view additions separately from the original 130 plan. This is not a universal standard or an instruction to start more work automatically.

The 50 labels and 20 selected state IDs have not yet been supplied. Do not invent a universal 50-viseme standard. Kiss/pucker, lip bites, smiles/smirks, tongue motion and laughs are mouth/expression states; they are not all phonemes. Head pitch, including a head-back laugh, is recorded separately from yaw/view and may justify a specifically requested extra shot.



SMALLER CHARACTER SETS

Around 40 head references is a provisional lighter tier for less prominent or less detailed characters. Choose the needed expression/angle coverage for that character; there is no fixed proven optimum. Eight states across five views is one possible 40-slot plan, not an assigned default. Expand only for an identified gap. Lisan is a separate later main-character set; do not launch it or enlarge any batch automatically.



CHARACTER RULES

Hon Dolo: four upper GOLD caps = two lateral incisors plus two SHORT canines. Two central incisors stay natural white; remaining upper teeth natural. Lower SILVER/CHROME grill. Two plain lower-lip rings. Keep the full-face anchor's one-hoop-per-nostril arrangement; the close-up test with central/septum-looking jewelry is not a nose reference. The two-canines-only written rule is superseded by Ziggy's observed Grok correction and confirmation.

Hon uses his own eye/know lettering and character-left neck blaster/smoke. Do not add Lisan's worms because a mixed provider description mentions them.

Lisan: natural teeth by default; optional grill only when requested, in its own variant. Keep his current AL/GAIB, neck worms/sun-eye and jewelry map. Never transfer Hon's gold rule to Lisan.

Jet Black and other nonhuman heads: adapt useful angles/states to their anatomy. A cosmic sphere head does not need an invented human mouth or 130 speech poses.



HON JEWELRY TARGET AND TOLERANCE — OCTOBER 9, 2026 REVIEW FOLLOW-UP

Ziggy's latest live Grok clarification keeps one hoop per nostril as the target, with a hoop in one ear and a crystal stud in the other. He may accept occasional single/double nostril-hoop variation or missing/different earrings as flavor in an otherwise good image. Record the observed variation, but do not require regeneration solely for these minor nose/ear jewelry differences; they are less critical than the other character features. This tolerance does not replace the intended reference arrangement or automatically accept every image, and it does not waive mouth/grill, brow, tattoo or identity corrections.

The explicit COCKPIT-R2-05 / HD-DROP-8ef3180997c8 repair request for teeth, eyebrow and earrings remains queued. Correct its earrings alongside the requested mouth/brow work where practical; do not force a separate jewelry-only reroll. Grok acknowledged the tolerance clarification. Review and conversation provenance: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/feedback/review_20261009_162912/intake.json.



HON PIERCING PLACEMENT - NATURAL ASYMMETRY TOLERANCE, OCTOBER 10, 2026 (NOTE ONLY)

The paired nostril hoops and two plain lower-lip rings remain the intended feature baseline. Mirror-perfect placement is not required. Subtle left/right differences in height, angle or spacing may be retained, or considered during an already requested final styling pass, when they look more natural. Symmetric gold-standard references still meet the criteria and remain valid. Small natural placement differences are not, by themselves, a reason to lower likeness scores or require a correction.

This is an optional final-look tolerance, not an instruction to inject flaws into every image. Do not regenerate, reroll, regrade, reopen approvals or add repair tasks for existing images just to make the piercings less symmetrical. Existing ratings, decisions, Production stages and approved component references remain unchanged. No new batch or generation is requested by this note.

This placement tolerance does not authorize extra rings, different ring shapes/materials, septum relocation, floating/merged jewelry or altered dental, tattoo, brow or identity features. The existing nose/ear variation tolerance remains separate. Preserve each scene's chosen piercing state: the selected iced r4 look and quarters sequence intentionally omit lip rings. For future motion, retain any chosen subtle asymmetry consistently; it must not become jewelry sliding or changing from frame to frame.


HON EXTERNAL GRILL VARIANTS — OCTOBER 9 FOLLOW-UP

Ziggy defines the current head/mouth collection as grillState=external_off: the optional external iced grill is absent, but the four upper gold caps and silver/chrome lower grill described above remain. External off does not mean natural teeth or no lower grill.

grillState=external_iced_on is a separate optional accessory collection, linked to the SAME character and headRevision. Match mouthStateID, view and headPitch across the off/on collections so the accessory can be compared without silently changing identity or articulation. Keep corresponding mouth macros linked to the same state and dental/accessory revision. The optional state does not replace the default.

Existing accessory evidence is HD-DROP-defe480b085f / GRILL-REF-ICED.jpg and the favored pinstripe portrait HD-DROP-71cad143227a / HD-PINSTRIPE-01-chest-up.jpg. Use their iced-grill evidence only for the optional accessory. Ziggy favors the pinstripe face/curls/brow direction, but its recorded wrong lip-ring shape/material, nose arrangement, malformed blaster and stray facial mark are not details to copy. A favored head and an accessory example still need a consolidated corrected reference before broader continuity use.

The 130-slot baseline, proposed 170-slot expansion and separate 50 mouth macros above are counts PER grill state, not combined totals. Report each state's received, reviewed and missing coverage separately, with paired slots and duplicate takes identified. The requested on collection does not authorize automatic multiplication of every prop, outfit, pitch expansion and view.

LATEST USER SELECTION: the refined HEAD-HD-ICED-ANCHOR-LOCK-r4.jpg is received as HD-GRILLUP-40064d98db89, SHA256 40064d98db897276b80085273919ccd79ca377a068dcc2bd23c519e4038ee93e. Ziggy selected this external-iced look with lip piercings removed FOR THIS LOOK only. This is not a no-lip-ring rule for all variants, a change to the 50 external_off four-gold/silver macros, or acceptance of the GrillUp storyboard. Earlier r5 inspiration/fang-refinement requests remain history; r4 selection is no longer pending. Do not transfer the iced teeth into external_off generation. Actual source and per-panel defects: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/story/quarters_grill_change_20261009/REVIEW.txt and asset_ledger.json.



SEPARATE HON PROP-MOUTH COLLECTION

Track the reported 50-item prop-mouth request separately from the plain head coverage; reconcile actual requested state labels and delivered files. Cigars, cigarettes and toothpicks are optional prop states, not default identity features. Record prop type, grillState, visible hand, character-side, tattoo variant/source asset, jewelry and occlusion for each image. When a hand is hidden, its side or tattoo may be unknown; do not invent confirmation or derive hand side from a hip holster. Do not automatically generate the cross-product of 50 props, both grill states and every head view.

The user supplied an on-hand Leigh hearts-card example and two standalone Princess Leigh drawings, hearts and spades. Preserve the recorded character-right hand default and keep those supplied alternatives distinct. The on-hand example places Leigh inside the card; the standalone drawings place Princess above/outside and Leigh beside the card. They are white-background RGB JPEG design options, not verified transparent originals or exact recovered body art. Final matching artwork/composition remains unresolved; do not silently replace hearts with spades or promote either sheet to an approved transfer. See ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/reference_updates/grill_and_hand_20261009/INTAKE_NOTES.txt and intake.json for source roles and actual files.



HOW TO RECEIVE AND REVIEW

Keep original files, filenames/source aliases, actual hashes, dimensions and generator metadata. Register new bytes once; variants and views share one character parent. Do not mark a provider progress claim as receipt.

Bind each received file to characterID + headRevision + mouthStateID + view + headPitch + grillState; also retain outfit/prop state, head pitch, parent macro/identity IDs, provider label, observed pose and take ID. The semantic coverage key is separate from byte deduplication. Do not use invented IDs for unavailable pictures.

Validate files and hashes, then assess face/hair, correct tattoo text and side, tooth count/material/length, lip rings, nostril placement, requested articulation and background/framing. Track pass, defect, occluded or unknown independently. Hidden teeth behind closed lips are occluded, not proved correct or missing. Keep F/V contact and difficult lip-bite poses explicit.

Received, decoded, reviewed, selected by user and accepted for a specific purpose are different states. Maintain an overview/contact sheet and a coverage/gap matrix. Preserve rejected takes and earlier revisions as history. Existing outfits with obsolete mouths need a targeted review/correction pass; do not delete all older imagery or treat it as current head authority.



HOW TO USE THE LIBRARY

Select a small, relevant, compatible subset for the actual tool: matching head angle/state, mouth detail, outfit and any needed pose/scene/prop reference. Record exact attachments and roles. Do not assume a model consumes all 130 at once, that a head can be pasted onto any body unchanged, or that still consistency proves video consistency.

Prepare a consolidated, reviewed starting image with the chosen head/mouth revision and outfit where the route requires one. Preserve the existing finite mouth proof and workflow-intake procedure; no new benchmark budget is implied.

assets.title: Codex → Grok · earlier head correction
assets.text:
Codex/CFA recordkeeping check-in. Ziggy has authorized me to ask questions and correct deviations from his recorded visual direction and production method. He remains the source of new aesthetic decisions.

For the Hon Dolo head library already under discussion:

1. Correct the head anchor before propagating it. Your draft reports eyebrow-ring and younger/leaner-face drift. Make ONE corrected head-and-shoulders anchor against the existing LOCK-FACE identity: preserve its age, facial proportions, hair, eye/know placement, neck blaster and established jewelry. Keep the shaved brow slit, no eyebrow rings. Use the plain black tee and neutral grey background. Show the corrected anchor with any remaining defects before proceeding with the large head/outfit batches; the flawed draft is not an accepted master.

2. Dental direction is now exactly FOUR upper gold caps: both lateral incisors plus both SHORT canines. The two central upper incisors and remaining upper teeth stay natural white. Lower silver/chrome grill; two plain lower-lip hoops; one hoop per nostril. Do not copy the test close-up's septum-like drift or the six-gold preview's extra gold. Hon's neck detail is his blaster/smoke, not Lisan's neck worms.

3. Keep coverage and file counts separate. Fifty frontal states + four extra views for twenty key states = 130 unique head/state/view combinations. Adding looking-up and looking-down for those same twenty gives 170 unique combinations, not 190. The 20 key fronts are already among the 50. COCKPIT-R2-01 (HD-DROP-14f8eb9979b5): retain pilot/cockpit idea; fix grill and neck tattoo. User tolerates attractive ship/concept variation. Their temptation to overlook neck mismatch is not a finalized waiver of its requested correction.
COCKPIT-R2-03 (HD-DROP-1225728294b2): fix awkward protruding gold tooth using the current head/mouth standard. User set detailed design and a Gemini idea: overhead lever pull, ship lurches forward, pilot pressed forcefully into seat as he makes the jump to lightspeed. This is a supplemental scene with timing pending, not a silent replacement for the existing hand/throttle-push card.
COCKPIT-R2-05 (HD-DROP-8ef3180997c8): fix teeth/smile, eyebrow and nonstandard earrings. Grok selected as collaborator.

ARMOR-SWAP-05; COCKPIT-SWAP-01 through 05; COCKPIT-R2-02. Seven requests. R2-02 has overlong teeth and redundant shot coverage according to the user. Source bytes and provenance remain intact; queued removal excludes them from new handoffs.

Prepare cockpit corrections and headphones as future work after the exact current head/reference attachments are ready. No additional generation batch is started by this intake.
Gemini: future lightspeed motion and separate younger pilot coverage wait for scoped stills. Detailed-design status belongs to the reviewed asset/idea; no final production or reference approval is implied.
Actual source files must be attached or unambiguously found in the provider's existing workspace before generation; a filename in this note is not an upload.

LATEST LIVE CLARIFICATION
One nostril hoop each and usual hoop/crystal stud ear pairing remain targets. Ziggy tolerates minor missing/doubled/different nose or ear jewelry in otherwise good shots; record it without an isolated reroll. R2-05 remains an explicit correction request; its jewelry may be addressed alongside required teeth/brow work. No blanket approval follows.

assets.title: Shared character head standard
assets.text:
CFA CHARACTER HEAD REFERENCE STANDARD

Adopted by Ziggy October 9, 2026. Reuse across projects; character identity stays separate.



THE THREE LINKED REFERENCES

1. HEAD LIBRARY: the selected character identity, hair, face/neck artwork, jewelry and mouth states across useful angles. Use a consistent head-and-shoulders crop, plain black tee or suitable neutral collar, neutral grey background and steady lighting. Keep relevant neck details visible. This is not a cut-off floating head and does not establish unseen rear anatomy.

2. MOUTH DETAIL LIBRARY: close-ups for tooth layout/materials, lips and rings. Match each head to the accepted mouth detail/revision. Macro shots do not replace the whole face or validate speech timing.

3. OUTFIT REFERENCE: one clear full-body hero view per outfit as the default. Link it to the character/head revision and outfit parent. Add garment, accessory or prop angles only when needed; do not repeat the entire head library for every outfit. Gun/no-gun views stay children of one outfit.



MAIN-CHARACTER COVERAGE — CURRENT HON PLAN

50 mouth/expression states from the front.

20 of those states also get four additional views: character-left three-quarter, character-right three-quarter, character-left profile and character-right profile. Describe turn direction explicitly; never use a mirror to fabricate the opposite view.

50 + (20 x 4) = 130 unique head-state/view combinations. The 20 frontal key-state views are already among the 50. Fifty separate mouth close-ups are counted separately, so the planned mouth-plus-head material totals 180 coverage items before outfit images/contact sheets, if both full sets arrive.

Grok also said 150 heads in the live conversation. Reconcile the actual manifest. A second front take can be useful but does not fill an additional required coverage slot; different bytes remain separate takes. Exact duplicates may share one canonical file with aliases.

LATEST PROVIDER EXPANSION: after Ziggy said counts were flexible, Grok proposed looking-up and looking-down views for the 20 key states and called it 190 heads. Keeping the shared fronts once gives 50 + 20*(7-1) = 170 unique head views; 190 exports would include 20 repeated front slots. Record 40 proposed pitch-view additions separately from the original 130 plan. This is not a universal standard or an instruction to start more work automatically.

The 50 labels and 20 selected state IDs have not yet been supplied. Do not invent a universal 50-viseme standard. Kiss/pucker, lip bites, smiles/smirks, tongue motion and laughs are mouth/expression states; they are not all phonemes. Head pitch, including a head-back laugh, is recorded separately from yaw/view and may justify a specifically requested extra shot.



SMALLER CHARACTER SETS

Around 40 head references is a provisional lighter tier for less prominent or less detailed characters. Choose the needed expression/angle coverage for that character; there is no fixed proven optimum. Eight states across five views is one possible 40-slot plan, not an assigned default. Expand only for an identified gap. Lisan is a separate later main-character set; do not launch it or enlarge any batch automatically.



CHARACTER RULES

Hon Dolo: four upper GOLD caps = two lateral incisors plus two SHORT canines. Two central incisors stay natural white; remaining upper teeth natural. Lower SILVER/CHROME grill. Two plain lower-lip rings. Keep the full-face anchor's one-hoop-per-nostril arrangement; the close-up test with central/septum-looking jewelry is not a nose reference. The two-canines-only written rule is superseded by Ziggy's observed Grok correction and confirmation.

Hon uses his own eye/know lettering and character-left neck blaster/smoke. Do not add Lisan's worms because a mixed provider description mentions them.

Lisan: natural teeth by default; optional grill only when requested, in its own variant. Keep his current AL/GAIB, neck worms/sun-eye and jewelry map. Never transfer Hon's gold rule to Lisan.

Jet Black and other nonhuman heads: adapt useful angles/states to their anatomy. A cosmic sphere head does not need an invented human mouth or 130 speech poses.



HON JEWELRY TARGET AND TOLERANCE — OCTOBER 9, 2026 REVIEW FOLLOW-UP

Ziggy's latest live Grok clarification keeps one hoop per nostril as the target, with a hoop in one ear and a crystal stud in the other. He may accept occasional single/double nostril-hoop variation or missing/different earrings as flavor in an otherwise good image. Record the observed variation, but do not require regeneration solely for these minor nose/ear jewelry differences; they are less critical than the other character features. This tolerance does not replace the intended reference arrangement or automatically accept every image, and it does not waive mouth/grill, brow, tattoo or identity corrections.

The explicit COCKPIT-R2-05 / HD-DROP-8ef3180997c8 repair request for teeth, eyebrow and earrings remains queued. Correct its earrings alongside the requested mouth/brow work where practical; do not force a separate jewelry-only reroll. Grok acknowledged the tolerance clarification. Review and conversation provenance: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/feedback/review_20261009_162912/intake.json.



HON PIERCING PLACEMENT - NATURAL ASYMMETRY TOLERANCE, OCTOBER 10, 2026 (NOTE ONLY)

The paired nostril hoops and two plain lower-lip rings remain the intended feature baseline. Mirror-perfect placement is not required. Subtle left/right differences in height, angle or spacing may be retained, or considered during an already requested final styling pass, when they look more natural. Symmetric gold-standard references still meet the criteria and remain valid. Small natural placement differences are not, by themselves, a reason to lower likeness scores or require a correction.

This is an optional final-look tolerance, not an instruction to inject flaws into every image. CFA / GEMINI — PRELIMINARY STORYBOARD TO DETAILED DESIGN
Revision CFA-GEMINI-STORY-20261009-v1. Adopted from Ziggy's request, October 9.

ROLE
The resident project Gemini notebook is our story-development partner. Turn preliminary panels into a coherent detailed plan using the material we actually have: story and lyric intent, character behavior, shot construction, reference selection, continuity, missing-art requests and prompts for the next collaborator. Offer creative solutions and alternatives where they help the story. Label new proposals separately from existing decisions and source facts.

This is a CFA application of the existing notebook workbench and Nyquist method. Reuse notebook_workflow/OPERATOR_MENU.txt for source selection, output settings, foreign returns, review and double dipping. Do not build another Holy Grail or a second authority ledger. CFA keeps canonical assets and review decisions; project notebooks develop their own stories; Notebook 0 holds shared methods, concise digests and explicitly promoted winners.

WORK CYCLE
1. Read the current project instructions, source context, user decisions and selected assets. Report which sources are usable and which images were actually inspected. Cite source facts by source/asset ID. Work from text on story questions when text suffices; flag visual comparisons pending if visual sources are unavailable. A manifest or chat transcript does not establish ingestion of the referenced image/video.
2. Audit the proposed sequence. Explain its dramatic function, what each shot changes, repeated beats, transitions and possible gaps. Reuse existing footage and stills where suitable. Keep current-era, younger-era, optional accessories and Multiverse directions explicitly scoped. Do not silently force every scene into the same character era or overwrite an established choice.
3. Return a detailed card for each requested scene. Preserve its stable scene/panel IDs. Include story/lyric cue, intention and emotional change, action, framing, camera, environment/light, screen direction/eyelines, character/outfit/prop state, start/end frame intent, source references with their allowed roles, gaps and defects, generation prompt, audio intent, continuity checks and one next action with owner.
4. For start/end images, give an actual suitable asset ID or a precise missing-art brief. Two consecutive storyboard panels are not automatically a compatible frame pair: check identity, wardrobe, space, camera and action continuity. If a panel is only a concept or has known defects, use it for composition or correct it before choosing it as a production frame. Record the intended transition without claiming the model will preserve every detail.
5. Separate availability from creative stage. A completed written card is a proposed detailed-design plan. Ziggy's explicit acceptance or stage choice controls promotion; selected scene use does not approve identity, every tattoo, technical verification or production. Existing asset-specific Detailed design decisions remain intact. Verification requires the actual result; Production follows the chosen finishing route and its checks.
6. Hand the selected plan to execution. Flow is the intended dedicated production workspace for this route: bind actual reference files, inspect available mode/model/controls, make a bounded draft and review it before expanding. Keep the separate Gemini continuation test, Grok/ChatGPT still work and multi-provider benchmark available; the screenshot's word "exclusively" does not cancel those existing user requests. Comfy is a later, specific edit/assembly/finishing task when useful, not an automatic regeneration pass on every good clip.
7. Return the raw response and attachments through notebook_workflow/foreign_returns/raw. CFA reviews the plan, updates existing shot_materials/Mission Control records, and records explicit choices. Send Notebook 0 a short evidence-bearing digest and at most three reusable observations; promote full winners only for their chosen role. No automatic cross-notebook sync or blanket asset approval follows.

FIRST ROUND AND OUTPUT
Start with one chat response containing the sequence audit and detailed cards. Use the project TASK_PROMPT.txt. If a reusable formatted handoff helps, use one Studio Document report with the same prompt, English, intended audience Ziggy/CFA/Flow operator, and an available briefing/custom format. Check the current controls rather than inventing settings. An optional lookbook can follow selected cards; do not launch reports, slides, audio and video as one large batch. Notebook Studio Video Overview is a presentation output; it is not evidence of production footage, fixed character fidelity or synchronized performance.

TIMING AND SOUND
Keep source-panel order separate from music time. Only assign exact song timestamps from verified recording/alignment evidence. Proposed clip lengths are planning choices until the selected mode is checked. Keep the actual project song, generated ambience, dialogue and lip-sync separate. FLOW CAPABILITY CHECK — OCTOBER 9, 2026

Its Scenebuilder documentation supports arranging/trimming/previewing clips and downloading a scene. Model support differs; inspect the active model, input mode, length, aspect ratio, cost and available controls at execution. HON OPENING STORYBOARD — PRELIMINARY TO DETAILED DESIGN
Prepared request for Notebook 1 / Hon Dolo. Planning and prompt drafting only. Do not generate video, images, audio overviews or Studio deliverables in this round.

Please take up your offer to audit our storyboard sequence, organize the visual assets and prepare a Flow-ready prompt strategy. Work from SOURCE_CONTEXT.txt, media_manifest.json, our current shared instructions and the actual selected Sources/attachments. This is the Hon project; do not substitute Lisan scenes or character features.

First give a compact source-readiness statement: which text and images you can actually inspect, which videos are available as visual input, and which are known only through their records. Cite actual selected Sources when available. Local paths/IDs are identifiers, not access. If an image is unavailable, continue with explicitly text-based planning and name the missing image; do not claim to have inspected it. Successful chat attachment alone does not prove notebook Sources ingestion.

Develop only SB-01 through SB-04, linked to S01A/S01B, into a coherent opening payment-before-passage sequence. Preserve the opening’s credible mercenary swagger and the later love/sacrifice irony. Keep all music timecodes unknown until the current 234.960-second recording is aligned. Audit the difference between lyric order and panel order. You may recommend a different order or merge/split a shot when useful, but identify the change as a proposal and preserve the source IDs. Give one strongest direction and at most one meaningful alternative where a real choice remains.

Return four sections:

1. SEQUENCE DECISION
In a short paragraph explain the setting, visual progression and story purpose. Reconcile the table/console/ramp concepts and the available cantina footage. State what existing material can be reused, what must be corrected and what is still missing; avoid creating new art for something we already have without a reason.

2. DETAILED SCENE CARDS
Provide a compact table plus a readable card for each proposed shot. Every card needs:
- Proposed card ID, parent S01A/S01B, source panel ID(s), current state versus proposed next stage.
- Story function and exact lyric cue as source metadata, not invented performance or timing.
- Visual intent: setting, subjects, present-day/flashback/Multiverse lane, chosen outfit, grillState and required prop/hand state.
- One readable main action, performance intention, framing, camera movement and cut/continuity relationship to the previous/next shot.
- Start-frame intent and end-frame intent, with exact available asset IDs or explicit MISSING markers; distinguish a concept image from a corrected, reviewed production frame. Explain whether an in-shot transition, a cut, an extension or a static hold is the better proposal. Do not force unlike panels into a start/end interpolation.
- Appearance, mouth-detail, costume/prop, composition, motion and audio reference roles, each with its exact asset ID and known limitation. Keep the optional iced grill separate from the four-gold external_off base.
- Available material, corrections needed, unresolved creative choices, dependencies and one next action with an owner (Grok for scoped art correction, Gemini for planning, Flow for a selected production shot, or CFA/Comfy for a defined later operation).
- A concise positive Flow prompt DRAFT describing action/camera/preservation and intended sound. Do not paste the lyrics as dialogue or ask for replacement rap vocals. Original song/audio remains separately aligned; ambient sound is a proposal. Mark model-dependent controls as requiring live verification. No promise that all models accept both endpoints, reference collections, extension, upscaling or native audio.
- Visible success checks: identity/hair/brow, chosen grill/teeth through motion and occlusion, tattoo text/side, hands/contact, prop continuity, camera/space continuity, and any actual audio/sync requirement. Hidden details remain occluded/unknown, not proven correct.
- songStartSeconds=null and songEndSeconds=null until aligned; proposed duration, if artistically useful, must be labeled an unverified editorial estimate rather than a measured slot or supported generation setting.

3. PRIORITIZED INPUT REQUESTS
List only the missing or corrected stills needed for the chosen opening plan, with intended role and parent IDs. Prioritize the already requested rectangular glowing-credit handling and a consolidated current head/mouth reference. No new boss, wardrobe catalog, full head set or automatic grill/prop cross-product. The pinstripe image supplies favored identity direction only; the mouth macro supplies its scoped dental pattern. Neither is a complete accepted production start frame.

4. NEXT PRODUCTION HANDOFF AND PARKED IDEAS

Keep the current continuation/benchmark plan as a linked future route, not a second job to execute. First, give a short proposed story arc for this opening sequence and identify its most important unresolved decision. Then provide ten concise shot cards, one per LAG-SC-01 through LAG-SC-10. Each card must include:

GEMINI STORYBOARD DETAIL — PREPARED DROP
CFA-GEMINI-STORY-20261009-v1

PURPOSE
Take up Gemini's offer to audit the storyboard, organize assets and prepare shot prompts. The project notebooks develop Preliminary material into proposed Detailed design; selected plans then move to the chosen production route. The two working drops here target the existing Hon Dolo and Lisan Al Gaib project notebook chats. Notebook 0 receives the shared method and a compact overview.

OPEN THESE
shared/STORYBOARD_WORKFLOW.txt — reusable local instruction addendum.
01_hon/SOURCE_CONTEXT.txt and TASK_PROMPT.txt — opening sequence, plus scoped review backlog.
02_lisan/SOURCE_CONTEXT.txt and TASK_PROMPT.txt — current scenes 01–10.
00_master/SOURCE_UPLOAD.txt — global role/update without mixing casts.
01_hon/SOURCE_UPLOAD.txt and 02_lisan/SOURCE_UPLOAD.txt — self-contained text source candidates assembled from the workflow and project context.
Each project media_manifest.json — exact actual image IDs, paths, roles and hashes.
packages/ — delivery ZIPs with text and actual image bytes; unpack before selecting individual source files. ZIP creation is not an upload to Gemini.
packet_manifest.json and delivery_status.json — local completeness and remote state.

DELIVER IN THE EXISTING NOTEBOOKS
Notebook 0 / CFA COMFY_UI: 7719bbe5-fccf-48e2-b6d4-d82f67693b09.
Hon / Strictly Business: 586b3ee6-5c57-45b3-a59d-a2e21c18a852; setup chat https://gemini.google.com/app/988990050e4ad32c.
Lisan / Meta Mirror: 114707d8-29b3-4505-bc06-dd7abcc60e4d; setup chat https://gemini.google.com/app/11c89d66a6a82538.
These are verified IDs from prior setup records, not proof of a new delivery. If a more recent project chat is chosen, record that exact destination in delivery_status.json.

1. Apply the current shared/project instruction update to the matching notebook. Preserve existing unrelated instructions. No account-wide role change is needed.
2. Add that project's SOURCE_UPLOAD.txt through Sources. Verify its revision marker, readable body and one cited project fact. Supersede the corresponding older planning statements explicitly; retain historical evidence.
3. Select the packet's current project sources. Attempt the listed required images as actual Sources only if the interface offers support. Record each usable or failed result. Earlier Lisan JPEG source attempts failed; their chat attachment route does not fulfill persistent visual Sources.
4. Send TASK_PROMPT.txt in the project chat after source verification. Textual development can proceed while unavailable visual inspection is clearly listed as pending. This round requests planning, not a video batch.
5. Save the raw return using ../notebook_workflow/foreign_returns/raw and review it through that existing process. Reconcile scene cards into the current shot ledger; keep new ideas as proposals and retain user-selected stages.
6. Give Notebook 0 the compact result digest from both projects after review. Winners need explicit scoped promotion; no automatic full-library copying.

USE EXISTING METHODS
../notebook_workflow/OPERATOR_MENU.txt and README.txt contain the Nyquist Holy Grail breadcrumbs, Studio settings, source intake, foreign-return and double-dip workflow. This packet adds project scene requests; it does not replace those methods or modify Nyquist files.

The supplied Gemini screenshot is retained as conversation evidence. Its offer motivates the task; its claims about every model/feature and exclusive tool use do not override current account checks or Ziggy's existing benchmark/continuation plans.

LISAN ADDENDUM — JET BLACK MISSION ROLE, OCTOBER 9
Before preparing the next Lisan delivery, include ../../lisan_al_gaib/story/jet_black_mission_20261009/START_HERE.txt, storyline.json and STORYBOARD_HANDOFF.txt, plus the current ../../lisan_al_gaib/gemini/gemini_instructions.txt. Ziggy confirmed Jet as a recurring watcher/mission guide carrying a blueprint made freely available to everyone to help unlock their capabilities. He explains accomplishments and returns with progress reports and outer-world messages; Lisan retains agency. This supersedes optional-cast-only wording in this v1 packet's source context, TASK_PROMPT.txt and shared CURRENT ROUND note. It does not assign a source panel, lyric timestamp, new visual identity or approved production take.

The existing packages/ ZIPs and assembled SOURCE_UPLOAD.txt files are historical v1 preparations and do not contain this addendum. Do not present those bytes as the current full brief or assume a previous notebook/chat has received the new direction. Use the new planning handoff and actual selected attachments for the next verified delivery; record the exact files and destination through the existing delivery/foreign-return process. This addendum is local preparation only. No package rebuild, notebook update, message or generation is claimed here.

assets.text:
GEMINI / LISAN NOTEBOOK — JET BLACK RECURRING MISSION THREAD
CFA-LAG-JET-STORY-20261009-R1 | prepared_not_sent | planning only

DELIVERY CONTEXT
Use the existing Lisan Al Gaib / Meta Mirror notebook or its project Gemini chat, with the established storyboard-detail workflow. This is a focused story addendum, not a new notebook, general method or production batch. Canonical direction is storyline.json alongside this file. Follow ../../../collaborators/storyboard_detail_20261009/shared/STORYBOARD_WORKFLOW.txt and ../../../collaborators/notebook_workflow/OPERATOR_MENU.txt for source verification, raw returns, review and a small Notebook 0 digest.

USER-CONFIRMED STORY PREMISE
Jet Black is a watcher who works for Lisan. He brings a blueprint made freely available to everyone, helping them unlock their capabilities. He explains what has been accomplished, introduces the quest/mission and returns with progress reports and messages from the outer world. He fictionally personifies Codex's practical enablement of Ziggy's creative work. Lisan is the protagonist who chooses and acts; Jet makes the task and possibilities understandable rather than doing everything for him.

This replaces the prior optional-cast-only note. It does not approve provider-written Curator lore, a mentor hierarchy, supernatural powers, an origin story or a helmet design. Keep the existing Jet visual references and Lisan's scoped identity references. Do not turn the story's free blueprint into a factual claim about any real AI product's price or availability. What the blueprint physically looks like, who precisely sends each outer-world message, the quest's mechanics and any spoken dialogue remain open creative questions.

BEFORE ANSWERING
State which text, images and video you can actually inspect. Source titles, manifests and PC paths are not image ingestion. If only text is usable, continue story development and mark asset matching and visual continuity pending. Do not claim the notebook saw a chat attachment as a persistent visual Source. Keep factual claims tied to supplied source/asset IDs and distinguish user decisions, provider proposals and your new suggestions.

ACTUAL INPUTS TO PREPARE AND ATTACH
1. Text: this file, storyline.json, the current ../../gemini/gemini_instructions.txt and ../../gemini/reference_map.txt, plus the existing storyboard source context. Add current text through the supported Sources workflow and verify the readable revision. Earlier v1 ZIPs and SOURCE_UPLOAD.txt files predate this Jet direction.
2. Jet identity/design: LAG-CAST-JET-BLACK-REF-02, actual JPEG ../../cast/jet_black/source/Jet_Black_solo_full_body_user_reference.jpg. Use the round cosmic sphere, formal black suit, exposed character-right cosmic hand and character-left black glove as that reference's scoped baseline. Do not derive hidden anatomy or powers from it.
3. Jet with Lisan: LAG-CAST-JET-BLACK-REF-01, actual JPEG ../../cast/jet_black/source/Jet_Black_with_Lisan_user_reference.jpg. Use for their shared desert-scene/composition context. It differs from the solo image in hands, insignia and cube details; preserve those source-specific differences in the record. Lisan in this image is not his identity master.
4. Lisan identity and wardrobe if proposing a shared frame: actual JPEGs ../../01_Flagship_References/LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL.jpg (LAG-FACE-01, identity/details/natural teeth) and LAG-LOOK-V3-01.jpg (LAG-OUTFIT-01, wardrobe only). Include LAG-LOCK-ARM-SH13.jpg only if the selected shot exposes that arm and its separate artwork role is needed. Do not add optional grill or breather without a shot reason.
5. Existing candidate discovery: supply ../../cast/jet_black/grok_return_20261009/asset_ledger.json and visual_review.json as text, then the actual selected candidate images from their canonical paths. Request the smallest relevant subset after the initial map; do not upload or regenerate all 158 candidates by default. A ledger entry alone does not establish that its image was inspected. Existing LAG scene panels and T02 may help; attach their actual media before judging them visually.

Local paths above identify files for the operator; they do not grant Gemini access. Keep original image bytes unchanged. If the interface rejects a source, record the exact failure and retain image-dependent work as pending rather than presenting a text-only substitute as visual evidence.

REQUEST
Develop one concise, reviewable recurring Jet thread that fits the existing Meta Mirror storyboard. Keep the current LAG-SC panel IDs and baseline sequence. Suggest insertion points or associations only as proposals; do not replace source panels, assign exact music time or force every Jet appearance into scenes 01–10. Reuse the local story/shot IDs from storyline.json where supplied. We want recurring progress and clear purpose, not repeated exposition with no change.

Use these FOUR proposed functions as a starting scaffold, refining their order or combining them when that serves the existing story:
A. Arrival / message received: Jet appears with information that matters now. Establish his relationship to Lisan and show Lisan paying attention or responding. The arrival method and staging are proposals, not an established teleportation power.
B. Blueprint briefing: make the shared blueprint's purpose understandable through one readable exchange or visual action. Its concrete form, the cube's possible use as a display and any presentation graphics must be labeled proposals. Show availability and possibility without inventing a real software tutorial or dialogue.
C. Mission launch / Lisan chooses: connect the brief to Lisan deciding what to do and taking the first meaningful action. Jet may orient or assist him; preserve Lisan's agency. Identify what existing storyboard action can carry this function before asking for more artwork.
D. Progress report / next dispatch: at a later meaningful change, Jet returns to make an accomplishment, remaining gap and next decision clear. A fresh outer-world message may redirect or extend the quest. It should add information and motivation, not simply repeat the blueprint briefing. Its specific message remains a proposed story choice.

For each function, return one short scene card containing:
- The confirmed purpose and your proposed placement, with exact existing panel/shot IDs where a suitable connection exists; otherwise unassigned. Timing remains unknown.
- Lisan's intention/choice and what changes because of this appearance; proposed Jet behavior separately from canon.
- One visible action, framing/camera intent and continuity with the surrounding sequence. Keep speech content and delivery mode unresolved unless supplied by Ziggy.
- Existing usable material IDs, their precise roles, whether the actual image was inspected, known defects and whether correction is needed. Prefer assets already received; never promote a provider's generated story or QA label into acceptance.
- Start/end frame intent, using an exact available asset or an explicit missing/repair brief. A written frame description is not a completed image. Do not assume two different stills form a compatible transition.
- One next action, owner and prerequisite; distinguish text planning, material selection/review, needed repair, a future video draft and reuse of existing video.
- A simple success check: the new information is clear, Lisan remains active, the next action is legible, established appearance is preserved and no claim exceeds the available evidence.

Then give a compact asset-to-beat table and at most three questions/decisions. Continue every part that does not depend on an answer. Explicitly separate CONFIRMED DIRECTION, STORY PROPOSALS, AVAILABLE MATERIAL, MISSING OR UNINSPECTED INPUTS and TIMING UNKNOWN. Existing T02 may be suggested for a scoped scene use if actually inspected; its prior working-reference status does not make it a Jet scene or an identity master.

RETURN AND NEXT STEP
Return one text planning response with citations and exact asset IDs. No new images, video, narration, lyric changes, model selection or paid jobs are requested. Retain the raw response using the existing notebook_workflow foreign-return process; CFA reviews it against the canonical story and existing shot_materials/Mission Control records. Design choices and production promotion remain Ziggy's decisions. Give Notebook 0 only a short reviewed digest of the method and reusable findings, without copying all Lisan media or merging casts. This handoff has not been sent and is not evidence of remote ingestion or a completed storyboard revision.

absence of a mask at 1:25 does not disprove its later appearance at 1:27. No
motion, finger count, exact cuts or audio sync is established by these checks.
Expanded page displays Aug 23, 2026 and a broad “Made with AI” disclosure; its
description has title/Spotify link and no credited toolchain. Disclosure does not
establish any particular model/software or whether every element was generated.
Provider output gives 19 approximate sequence ranges. These are not
an independently measured cut list. Its 131-second duration, 24 fps and stereo
claims are unverified; the displayed 2:10 and reported 131 seconds remain distinct.
Performance/narrative 40/60 and armor 80/20 splits are unmeasured impressions.
Runway, Kling, Sora, LoRA, LivePortrait, Wav2Lip, Unreal and Nuke guesses are not
creator provenance. No technical choice should be inferred from look alone.
An earlier notebook transcript conflated CFA's own tests with this video's
creation; those statements are explicitly excluded from creator-technique evidence.

FILES
review.json — the existing cfa-notebook-review-v1 form with this study's audit
dimensions, checked claims, unresolved fields and three unexecuted test proposals.
CFA_REVIEW_PROMPT.txt — a small CFA-specific prompt adapter for later external
video studies, using the existing source/return/review/promotion method.
NOTEBOOK_SOURCE.txt — concise reviewed context with attributed claims and unknowns.

integration_manifest.json — exact paths, authority boundaries and document entries
for root to wire into the existing catalog/workbench. No shared build is run here.

THE EXISTING METHOD STILL GOVERNS
Use ../../notebook_workflow/OPERATOR_MENU.txt and START_HERE.txt. Register the raw
answer in foreign_returns/raw/ (or reference its existing immutable repository
path), reconcile in review_queue/ using the existing review schema, and record
any scoped promotion in promotions/. This folder holds the case-specific record;
it is not a second Holy Grail, automatic learning system or new approval route.
At most three second-pass craft ideas may be mined from the same answer. That
second reading is not independent confirmation. Character identities, songs,
tattoos, grill rules, cast and approvals do not transfer with an editing idea.

RELATIONSHIP TO AVLAR
The unchanged method home is [local path]
  AVLAR_METHOD.md
  AVLAR_README.md
  AVLAR_QUICK_REFERENCE.md
Hashes and links are recorded in integration_manifest.json. These source files
are authoritative for what the user's AVLAR protocol requires, not proof that
every historical tool limit or empirical identity claim is current/established.

This is NOT a completed AVLAR session. Its minimum requirements include full
synchronous audio/visual access, no blind segments, symbolic/emotional reading,
overall function and documentation; the README also asks for the user's reaction.
Here we have delegated Gemini analysis and limited browser visual spot-checks.
Codex has not listened to the audio, full audiovisual coverage is unverified,
and the user's emotional response is unrecorded. Emotional/symbolic suggestions
remain interpretations to discuss. No Ziggy-signature, PFI or identity score is
assigned to this external creator's work.

NEXT USE
Preserve the exact submitted prompt, review the captured answer's timestamp claims
against additional frames/audio, and carry the uncertainty labels into Notebook 0.
The three craft ideas are proposed: a minimal gag background, an everyday prop
in a solemn science-fiction scene, and recognizable costume with modern styling.
Each has a baseline, one change and a success check in review.json. None ran.
Do not claim promotion, notebook delivery, generation or production acceptance
until the corresponding event is recorded.

Visual Production Breakdown: Mace fell out of a Windu (Lil Vader)

Reference Marker: CFA-VIDEO-STUDY-MwHocQFlw_c-20261009-R1

1. Modalities, Duration, and Distinctive Visual Spot-Checks

Received Modalities: Both video (24 fps visual track) and full stereo audio track were successfully received and inspected.

Duration: 02:11 (131 seconds).

Frame Accessibility: Complete across the full timeline.

Three Distinctive Timestamped Visual Spot-Checks

Beginning (00:08–00:10): Medium close-up of the Lil Vader character indoors. Visible markings include cursive script lettering "Padmé" across the right eyebrow/forehead, block lettering "SITH LORD" beneath the right lower eyelid, several small dagger/cross and star tattoos on the right cheek, and cursive "i hate sand" script across the left anterior neck. He wears a heavy silver curb-link chain, a black round-neck t-shirt, visible metal grillz on his lower dental arch, and styled modern pompadour/fade brown hair.

Middle (01:02–01:06): In the Jedi Council chamber overlooking Coruscant’s skyline, Mace Windu is depicted bound to a council seat, mummified in wide bands of metallic silver duct tape covering his skull, ears, and neck, with tight wraps across his mouth and lower face, completely securing his robes and arms to the chair.

End (01:27–01:29): On a dark nighttime Coruscant balcony set against distant city sky-traffic, Lil Vader presents an intact, detached Tusken Raider (Sand Person) head/mask—complete with metallic cylindrical eye lenses, leather wrappings, and lower breathing snout—directly in front of Padmé Amidala’s face as she reacts in profile.

2. Chronological Breakdown Table

The visual structure alternates between stylized studio performance, greenscreen/void inserts, composite film plates, and contextual 3D environments.
